sql_infos.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1960 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 3.17 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' ) GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM scoring s JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE s.g > 25 AND a.year >= 1967 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 67.42 AND s.a > 60.26 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 28.29 AND s.pts >= 79.4 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 185.61 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 14.56 AND s.a < 12.95 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1987.34 AND 1991.81 AND s.g >= 30.95 AND s.pts > 31.02 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 88.57 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 85.04 AND AVG(s.pts) > 86.72 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 2003 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.g > 28 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 32 AND t.w > 38 AND s.year >= 1998 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 89 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 1993 AND s.g >= 35 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1997 AND s.pts > 67 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.pts > 80 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2006 AND s.pts > 64 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.pts > 22 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1987 AND s.pts > 130 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2012.48 AND s.pts > 120.81 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 71 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 27 AND s.pts > 136 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 9 AND g.gp::integer > 13 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1998 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.g > 27 AND s.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2011 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING AVG(s.g) > 6.17 ORDER BY s.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points_per_player, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS percentile_75_goals FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1959 AND s.year <= 1916 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3322 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 1908 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1918 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.playerid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 497 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp >= 68 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 67 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' AND lgid = 'NHL') AND t.g >= 11.59 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 61.43 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1959 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3232 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 2020 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 232 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 15 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') AND t.w > 47 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4991 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 2006 AND t.rank1 <= 11 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 29 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1953 AND s.g >= 33 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 18 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 2016 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 302 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 32 AND s.pts >= 116 AND t.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 1998 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 445 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 14 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 45 AND s.pts >= 199 AND t.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 2005 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 431 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 14 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 1963 AND t.g > 54 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 72 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.13 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.w DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 2013 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1735 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1904 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 84 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga HAVING (t.gf - t.ga) > 83 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.g, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pts_3yr_rolling, AVG(t.gf) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_gf_3yr_rolling FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.pts > 70 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.g, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.rank1, t.lgid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1934 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.rank1, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 639 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1935 AND t.year <= 1922 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN teams t ON ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.year >= 2000 AND t.w >= 10 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1912 AND t.year <= 1922 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1934 AND t.year <= 1907 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1910 AND s.pts > 69 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1929 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1913 AND t.year <= 2020 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND s.g >= 66 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 1963 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1904 AND t.year <= 2016 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4724 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1999 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND s.g >= 76 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1982 AND t.year <= 1955 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3815 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(g.gp::integer) AS avg_goalie_games FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 5822 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 2004 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 47 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1948 AND 1936 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins_per_team FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1969 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 34 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 1917 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 41 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1980 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) > 7 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.tmid, ', ' ORDER BY t.tmid) AS team_list, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1947 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 49 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top3_finishes, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games_played, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(CASE WHEN s.pts > 73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 2018 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, top3_finishes DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 2009 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 1924 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 492 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 1914 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 295 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1913 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1980 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 232 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1970 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 24) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 53 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1971 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1967 AND t.year <= 1960 AND s.gp >= 92 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3554 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1971 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1926 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 491 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1922 AND 1979 AND t.g > 57 AND s.gp > 61 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 210 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1955 AND t.year <= 2002 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 37 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) < 0.87 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid) AS awards_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1935 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 11 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Record' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Record' ELSE 'Even Record' END AS record_category, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 11 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Record' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Record' ELSE 'Even Record' END AS record_category, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 89 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Even' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 2014 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 43 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 2003 AND s.gp >= 24 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 99 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against, SUM(t.gf) - SUM(t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC, SUM(t.gf) - SUM(t.ga) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1990 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 41 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 28 AND t2.w > 21 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 35 AND t2.w > 40 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2000.27 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT s.playerid, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals_per_season, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS percentile_75_points_per_season FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1955 AND s.year <= 1992 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 145 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2013 AND s.pts > 117 AND s.g >= 33 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 25 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 5 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 70 AND s.pts > 113 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 2 AND g.gp::integer > 34 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2013 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 144 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS team_goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1977 AND s.gp > 64 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.p_id, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 483 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, team_name, player_lastname;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1927 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4782 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 1952 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 75 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid), 0) AS award_players_count, AVG(ts.hw + ts.rw) FILTER (WHERE ts.hw IS NOT NULL AND ts.rw IS NOT NULL) AS avg_split_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON tp.year = sp.year AND (tp.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR tp.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 2020 AND t.w > 15 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) > 11 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, playoff_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1967 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND s.gp > 96 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 36 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1999 AND s.pts > 122 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1981 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 715 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1963 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND s.g >= 5 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1977 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2596 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.tmid, ', ' ORDER BY t.tmid) AS team_list, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 2010 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 74 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.tmid, ', ' ORDER BY t.tmid) AS team_list, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 2019 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 12 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.pos, ', ' ORDER BY s.pos) AS positions_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 1971 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 1965 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 156 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1904 AND t.g > 45 AND s.gp > 93 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 33 ORDER BY t.year DESC, yearly_rank, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.t) AS total_ties, SUM(t.gf) AS goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS goals_against, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_player_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_player_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, SUM(s.pim) AS total_player_pim, SUM(gp.gp) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(gp.w) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(gp.l) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(gp.t) AS total_goalie_ties, SUM(gp.ga) AS total_goalie_ga, SUM(gp.sho) AS total_goalie_shutouts, SUM(c.g) AS coach_games, SUM(c.w) AS coach_wins, SUM(c.l) AS coach_losses, SUM(c.t) AS coach_ties, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_losses, SUM(sp.t) AS playoff_ties, SUM(sp.gf) AS playoff_gf, SUM(sp.ga) AS playoff_ga FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc gp ON t.year = gp.year AND t.tmid = gp.tmid JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid JOIN teamspost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1938 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 84 AND SUM(t.w) > 65 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1919 AND t.year <= 1937 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 80 ORDER BY t.year, win_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf) - SUM(t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY (SUM(t.w) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.g), 0)) DESC) AS league_win_pct_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 1962 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 59 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goal_differential DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 31 AND t2.w > 59 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 60 AND t2.w > 58 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 24 AND t2.l < 21 AND t1.year >= 1989 AND t2.year <= 1997 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 36 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 70 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 19 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 14 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 34 AND t2.w > 41 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1977 AND ac.award = 'None' );
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 2000 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 1.99 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.playerid, m.lastname, m.firstname, sq.total_points, sq.total_goals, sq.total_assists FROM master m JOIN ( SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1948 GROUP BY s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6349 ) sq ON m.playerid::character varying = sq.playerid::character varying WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = sq.playerid AND ap.year IN ( SELECT ap2.year FROM awardsplayers ap2 WHERE ap2.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) ) ORDER BY sq.total_points DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1996 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2010 AND lgid = 'None';
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2002 ) AND pts > 24 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 36.71 AND s.a > 63.11 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 25.7 AND s.pts >= 65.22 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 252.73 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 11.84 AND s.a < 14.93 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1986.27 AND 1993.82 AND s.g >= 27.27 AND s.pts > 60.01 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 65.86 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 51.27 AND AVG(s.pts) > 69.85 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 52.58 AND s.a > 68.25 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 28.68 AND s.pts >= 62.75 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 294.44 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 7.91 AND s.a < 8.03 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1981.12 AND 2002.37 AND s.g >= 17.72 AND s.pts > 42.42 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 191.43 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 93.56 AND AVG(s.pts) > 40.42 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 20 AND t.w > 52 AND s.year >= 2003 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 15 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 27 AND t.w > 49 AND s.year >= 1992 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 70 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 43 AND t.w > 29 AND s.year >= 1995 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 52 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1991.04 AND s.g > 81.42 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 1980 AND s.g >= 46 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 2019 AND s.g >= 21 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 26 AND l < 5 ) AND s.g > 15 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1992 AND s.pts > 68 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2004.03 AND s.pts > 80.55 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 52 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2013 AND s.pts > 34 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 95 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 77 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.pts > 45 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2020 AND s.pts > 77 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 36 AND s.pts > 88 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 3 AND g.gp::integer > 17 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 2015 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 119 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2018 AND t.w >= 26 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 20 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, MIN(gp.gp) AS min_games_played, MAX(gp.gp) AS max_games_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN goaliessc gp ON s.playerid = gp.playerid AND s.year = gp.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 2007 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 11 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.lgid, s.pos), (t.lgid), ()) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1483 ORDER BY t.lgid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(gs.gp AS INTEGER)) AS avg_games_played, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1934 AND s.gp > 34 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.tmid, s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 426 ORDER BY total_points DESC, distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.gp >= 51 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 273 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS team_goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON ac.coachid = c.c_id AND t.year = c.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1946 AND t.year <= 2019 AND s.gp > 57 AND ap.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.g) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 29 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1964 AND s.g > 35 GROUP BY t.name, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 119 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, s.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, AVG(ts.g) AS avg_games_per_half, SUM(ts.w) AS total_wins, SUM(ts.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1994 AND ts.half = 2 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(ts.w) > 28 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, AVG(ts.g) AS avg_games_per_half, SUM(ts.w) AS total_wins, SUM(ts.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 2005 AND ts.half = 1 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(ts.w) > 21 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1914.7 AND a.award LIKE '%Hart%' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9690.44 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1960 AND t.w > 90 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4415 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 335 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1976 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 286 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 36 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') AND t.w > 34 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 968 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1931 AND t.year <= 1925 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 8721 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING t.w > 19 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(ts.hw + ts.hl + ts.ht) AS avg_home_games, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.w > sp.l THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 2021 AND (t.w > 54 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy')) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 274 AND AVG(t.ga) < 130 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins, COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) AS playoff_losses FROM teams t LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner WHERE t.year >= 1935 AND t.year <= 1941 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING t.w > 14 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts AS player_points, s.pim, m.lastname, m.firstname FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2000 AND (t.w > 34 OR t.l < 82) AND NOT (t.pts < 35) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, m.lastname, m.firstname ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalties FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 47 AND t.year >= 2019 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 132 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2005 AND s.g > 35 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1931 AND t.year <= 1960 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 17 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1968 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 13 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1994 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 81 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'N' AND s.pos LIKE 'C' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 216.01 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.gp) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE s.year >= 2016 AND s.g > 21 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 110 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1954 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.88 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1975 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3836 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_pts_3yr, SUM(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS cumulative_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 1987 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 43 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC) AS rank_by_pts FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE playerid = 3830) AND t.pts > 70 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, th.half HAVING SUM(th.g) > 60 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_by_pts;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 25 AND t.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 2019 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 43 AND t.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1993 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, AVG(t.g) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_games_per_season, SUM(t.w) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1992 AND t.pts > 111 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.lgid, t.g HAVING SUM(t.w) > 90 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 2013 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1906 AND t.year <= 1906 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1912 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE ap.year >= 2012 AND t.g >= 61 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1938 AND s.pts > 149 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1918 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2020 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 1981 AND s.pts > 127 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1922 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1959 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 1902 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1933 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.year <= 1978 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND s.g >= 15 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND s.g >= 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3490 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 1902 AND s.gp > 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 239 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 2015 AND s.gp > 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 248 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1979 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 456 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.lastname, ', ' ORDER BY m.lastname) AS player_names, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 16 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ' ORDER BY t.name) AS team_names, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 2013 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 29 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.tmid, ', ' ORDER BY t.tmid) AS team_list, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1977 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 25 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 1950 AND s.gp > 49 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 1939 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1053 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 2010 AND s.gp >= 46 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 40 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 2013 AND s.gp >= 67 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4848 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1945 AND t.year <= 1976 AND s.gp > 85 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 458 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1947 AND s.gp >= 29 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1984 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 456 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1952 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

c.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year JOIN awardsmisc am ON t.year = am.year JOIN hof h ON t.year = h.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN combinedshutouts cs ON t.year = cs.year JOIN goaliessc gsc ON t.year = gsc.year AND t.tmid = gsc.tmid JOIN goaliesshootout gso ON t.year = gso.year AND t.tmid = gso.tmid JOIN scoringsc ssc ON t.year = ssc.year AND t.tmid = ssc.tmid JOIN scoringshootout sso ON t.year = sso.year AND t.tmid = sso.tmid JOIN scoringsup sup ON t.year = sup.year JOIN teamsplits tspl ON t.year = tspl.year AND t.tmid = tspl.tmid JOIN teamvsteam tvt ON t.year = tvt.year AND t.tmid = tvt.tmid JOIN teamshalf tsh ON t.year = tsh.year AND t.tmid = tsh.tmid JOIN abbrev a ON t.lgid = a.code WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1917 AND ts.g >= 55 AND ts.w >= 19 AND s.pts >= 125 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3106 AND SUM(ts.w) > 70 AND AVG(c.w::numeric / NULLIF(c.g::numeric, 0)) > 0.85 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(s.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 1990 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM MAKE_DATE(t.year, 1, 1)) = 2 AND s.gp > 81 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 714 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 2 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING AVG(t.gf) > 195 ORDER BY t.year DESC, avg_goals_for DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1987 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 207 ORDER BY total_goals_for DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2002 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 24 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1928 AND 2004 AND t.g > 44 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND m.birthcountry = 'CAN' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 22 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1996 AND t.g > 48 AND s.gp > 64 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.66 ORDER BY total_games DESC, win_percentage DESC;
