SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1934 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1905 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 23 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 34 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Even' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 1994 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 28 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1919 AND t.rank1 > 23 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 4 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1910 AND t.w > 47 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 0 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w) * 100.0) / SUM(t.g), 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf) * 1.0) / SUM(t.ga), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1930 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 79 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, m.playerid, m.lastname, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_award_occurrences, MAX(g.sho) AS max_shutouts, COUNT(DISTINCT g.year) AS seasons_played_as_goalie FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goalies g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1908 AND s.gp >= 21 AND (s.pts >= 7 OR s.pts IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, m.playerid, m.lastname, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 329 OR GROUPING(t.tmid) = 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.playerid, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT g.sho) FILTER (WHERE g.sho::integer > 0) AS shutouts_with_goalie, MAX(sp.w) AS max_playoff_wins_by_team, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.half = 1 THEN ts.gf ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_goals_for, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.half = 2 THEN ts.gf ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goalies g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamshalf ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 1997 AND t.g >= 27 AND s.gp >= 57 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.playerid, m.lastname), (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 287 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 2020 AND s.g >= 59 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3587 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) ) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 25 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 1983 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 51 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS win_rate_rolling_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.w DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 1924 AND t.pts >= 51 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, league_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS teams_last_4_years FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.w > 67 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, t.w ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 31 AND t2.w > 41 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 58 AND t2.l < 29 AND t1.g >= 67 AND t2.g >= 66 AND t1.year >= 1990 AND t2.year <= 1984 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 51 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 69 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 42.29 AND t2.w > 32.11 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 62 AND t2.w > 22 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_current, t2.w AS wins_previous, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year + 1 AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 47 AND t2.w > 29 AND t1.year >= 2021 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 34 AND t2.w > 67 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1957 AND 2004 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1974.41 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2018.01 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2001.57 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 2.85 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1994 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2006 AND lgid = 'None';
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.pts > 34 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1998 AND s.pts > 63 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 23 AND s.pts > 56 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 7 AND g.gp::integer > 59 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1986 AND 2012 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 122 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1990 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 46 AND SUM(s.a) > 124 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2000 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 97 AND SUM(s.a) > 89 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 1996 AND s.gp > 23 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 448 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname, m.lastname, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_game, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.tmid = tsc.tmid AND t.year = tsc.year JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.g > 85 AND th.half = 1 AND tp.g > 27 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.year HAVING AVG(s.g) > 0.47 AND SUM(s.pts) > 72 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_goals_per_game DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank_in_league FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.lgid = ac.lgid AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON ac.coachid = c.c_id AND t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1999 AND s.gp > 68 AND s.pts > 79 AND ap.award IS NOT NULL AND c.w > 87 AND sp.w > 7 AND th.gf > 458 AND tp.gf > 2 GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 AND SUM(s.g) > 3 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, m.firstname AS player_firstname, s.g AS goals_scored, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS total_points, g.sho AS shutouts, c.w AS coach_wins, sp.w AS playoff_wins, AVG(ts.g) AS avg_team_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hart_trophy_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN goaliessc g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN teamssc ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND t.year <= 1988 AND (s.pts > 108 OR s.g > 25) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL' AND t.playoff = 'Y') AND (c.w IS NULL OR c.w > 57) AND (g.sho IS NULL OR g.sho > 10) AND (sp.w IS NULL OR sp.w < 11) AND (ap.award IS NULL OR ap.award NOT IN ('Lady Byng Trophy', 'Calder Trophy')) GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.g, s.a, s.pts, g.sho, c.w, sp.w, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 108 AND AVG(ts.g) BETWEEN 86 AND 81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) <= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1926 AND t.w > 86 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1210 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.year <= 1996 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 446 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1916 AND t.year <= 1955 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 23 AND t.w < 31) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 35 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 2022 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 21) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 67 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 8 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN master m ON a.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1989 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 48 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN master m ON a.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.w > 26 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 17 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.g) > 480 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 2011 AND t.g > 29 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2568 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_pts_per_game FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1944 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.lgid, s.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1903 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 63 UNION ALL SELECT g.tmid, g.year, SUM(CAST(g.w AS INTEGER)) AS total_wins, AVG(CAST(g.gp AS INTEGER)) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS unique_goalies FROM goalies g JOIN awardsplayers ap ON g.playerid = ap.playerid AND g.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON g.playerid = m.p_id WHERE g.year >= 1977 AND g.year <= 2005 AND ap.award = 'Vezina Trophy' GROUP BY g.tmid, g.year HAVING SUM(CAST(g.w AS INTEGER)) > 59 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts AS player_pts, m.lastname, m.firstname, a.award FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year = 1999 AND t.w > 41 AND (s.g > 53 OR s.a > 81) AND NOT (t.l > 31) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, m.lastname, m.firstname, a.award ORDER BY t.pts DESC, player_pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1964 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 988 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1935 AND t.year <= 1909 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1924 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4063 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1922 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1952 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.year <= 1961 AND s.g > 64 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 469 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1996 AND s.gp > 73 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 437 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 2019 AND s.gp > 41 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 220 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1944 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4171 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 1918 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 38 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 97 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1957 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) > 5 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1970 AND (t.w > 48 OR t.l < 51) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 6 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1977 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 382 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1995 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1964 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 361 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(t.g AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(t.w, 0)) AS avg_goals_per_win, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, SUM(COALESCE(gp.gp, 0)) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(COALESCE(gs.gp, 0)) AS total_scoring_games, ROUND(AVG(SUM(s.pts)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goaliessc gp ON t.year = gp.year AND t.tmid = gp.tmid LEFT JOIN scoringsc gs ON t.year = gs.year AND t.tmid = gs.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1903 AND t.g > 90 AND s.gp > 63 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.g, t.w HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4907 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 50 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2008 AND t.g > 32 AND s.gp > 32 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 22 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(*) AS seasons_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1982 AND t.year <= 1997 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 2 AND AVG(t.g) >= 22 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE w > 55) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 44 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1982 AND t.w > 10 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND m.birthcountry = 'CAN' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 42 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 1928 AND t.w > 37 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3859 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 2020 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.name AS team_name, t1.lgid AS league, t1.year AS season, SUM(t1.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t1.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t1.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_points_by_scorer, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award = 'Stanley Cup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stanley_cup_awards FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid <> t2.tmid JOIN teams t3 ON t1.year = t3.year AND t1.lgid = t3.lgid AND t1.tmid <> t3.tmid AND t2.tmid <> t3.tmid JOIN scoring s ON t1.year = s.year AND t1.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t1.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE year > 1919 AND year < 2011 GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tmid) > 32) AND t1.w > 25 AND t1.rank1 < 11 AND h.year > 1952 GROUP BY t1.name, t1.lgid, t1.year HAVING SUM(t1.w) > 81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 77 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 14 AND t2.w > 38 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 35 AND t2.w > 47 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 30 AND t2.l < 8 AND t1.year >= 1991 AND t2.year <= 2009 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 57 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 36 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 8 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 12 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 25.33 AND t2.w > 46.19 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 76 AND t2.w > 4 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' AND year > ( SELECT MIN(year) FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' ) ) AND s.year >= 1992 GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 320 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 1971 AND s.g > 82 AND t.w > 24 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1996 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 42) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 755 AND SUM(s.a) > 536 AND COUNT(*) >= 7 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 63.97 AND s.a > 50.31 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 34.3 AND s.pts >= 117.55 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 230.47 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 13.48 AND s.a < 12.2 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1986.42 AND 2009.39 AND s.g >= 28.11 AND s.pts > 20.32 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 187.66 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 91.48 AND AVG(s.pts) > 86.98 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2010 AND s.pts > 79 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2012 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(s.pts) > (SELECT AVG(pts) FROM scoring WHERE year = 2003) ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 1994 AND s.g >= 41 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 332 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 1981 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 84 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_rate, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE w > 66 AND year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1946) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.94 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, SUM(t.gf) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS cumulative_gf, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.playerid IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_player_awards_count FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.w > 18 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rate_3yr_rolling DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN master m ON a.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.w > 24 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 73 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND t.year <= 1964 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 96 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1955 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6682 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1919 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 2000 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 2020 AND s.gp > 49 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 250 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.w) AS median_wins, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.g) AS percentile_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 2000 AND t.w > 78 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 26 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1916 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) > 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.name, ', ' ORDER BY t.name) AS team_names, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 1986 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 39 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1935 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 74 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1904 AND s.gp >= 52 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1695 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.gp > 37 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 485 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 1944 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 230 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1955 AND t.year <= 1983 AND s.gp >= 32 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 1987 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1938 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 271 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1921 AND t.g > 45 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 346 ORDER BY total_games DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1982 AND t.g > 56 AND s.gp > 90 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 51 ORDER BY t.year DESC, yearly_rank, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 2001 AND t.w > 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2716 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1987 AND s.gp >= 10 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3850 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1986 AND 1993 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 38 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 47 AND t2.w > 38 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 6 AND t2.w > 67 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_current, t2.w AS wins_previous, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year + 1 AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 35 AND t2.w > 61 AND t1.year >= 1912 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 2002.08 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' ) GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 38 AND t.w > 35 AND s.year >= 2020 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 16 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 84 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1982 AND s.pts > 53 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 53 AND s.pts > 28 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 10 AND g.gp::integer > 51 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2009 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 120 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 67 AND s.pts > 56 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 4 AND g.gp::integer > 36 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 1998 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN master m ON a.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 29 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.lgid, t.name FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.w > 42 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.lgid, t.name UNION SELECT tp.tmid, tp.year, tp.w, tp.l, tp.g, tp.gf AS pts, tp.lgid, a.fullname AS name FROM teamspost tp JOIN abbrev a ON tp.lgid = a.code WHERE tp.year >= 1904 AND tp.w > 20 GROUP BY tp.tmid, tp.year, tp.w, tp.l, tp.g, tp.gf, tp.lgid, a.fullname ORDER BY year DESC, pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE ap.year >= 2015 AND t.g >= 11 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 2015 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(CAST(g.sho AS INTEGER)) AS total_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1922 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1468 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins_per_team FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1944 AND t.year <= 1921 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 73 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1915 AND s.gp > 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 239 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1911 AND t.year <= 1969 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND NOT (t.w < 30 OR t.l > 26) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 332 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 12 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2005 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2007) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.p_id = s.playerid WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.g > 67 GROUP BY m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2006.86 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2019.56 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.year) AS award_years, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' AND year > ( SELECT MIN(year) FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' ) ) AND s.year >= 2000 GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 426 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(h.year) AS latest_hof_year FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying JOIN awardsplayers a ON m.playerid::character varying = a.playerid::character varying AND s.year = a.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE s.year >= 1903 AND s.year <= 1971 AND s.gp >= 2 AND a.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 148 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) >= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, latest_hof_year DESC NULLS LAST;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1981 ) AND pts > 123 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 2020 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1981 AND s.g > 41 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 138.52 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 55.94 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 42.74 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1992.13 AND s.g > 25.2 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 211.78 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1996.62 AND s.g > 93.03 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2013 AND s.g > 34 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2018 AND s.g > 50 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2018.04 AND s.g > 52.55 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 35 AND l < 7 ) AND s.g > 10 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 54.83 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 15.33 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 55 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 14 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 67.47 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 54.74 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1999 AND s.pts > 62 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2009 AND s.pts > 94 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1989 AND s.pts > 43 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2007 AND s.pts > 145 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.pts > 57 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2002 AND s.pts > 92 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2002 AND s.pts > 94 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2010 AND s.pts > 98 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 34 AND s.pts > 112 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 3 AND g.gp::integer > 33 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 2010 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 54 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 52 AND s.pts > 99 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 2 AND g.gp::integer > 59 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 2000 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 74 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 69 AND s.pts > 91 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 10 AND g.gp::integer > 32 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 2001 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 72 AND s.pts > 58 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 1 AND g.gp::integer > 51 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 2006 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1996 AND s.pts > 49 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1991 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 51 AND SUM(s.a) > 97 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.gp >= 68 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 666 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(CAST(g.sho AS INTEGER)) AS total_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND t.year <= 1909 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2456 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1966 AND t.g >= 80 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 298 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.lastname, ', ' ORDER BY m.lastname) AS hall_of_famers, COUNT(DISTINCT h.hofid) AS hof_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN master m ON t.lgid = m.hofid JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid AND t.year = h.year WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.w >= 65 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.hofid) > 17 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year WHERE t.year >= 1914 AND t.year <= 1974 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.playerid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 105 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) AS seasons_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1926 AND s.g > 94 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 10 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank_in_league FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.lgid = ac.lgid AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON ac.coachid = c.c_id AND t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2010 AND s.gp > 75 AND s.pts > 1 AND ap.award IS NOT NULL AND c.w > 56 AND sp.w > 1 AND th.gf > 148 AND tp.gf > 121 GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 5 AND SUM(s.g) > 83 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.year <= 2018 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 41 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) AS award_years, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.lgid = a.lgid AND t.year = a.year WHERE t.w > 0 AND t.year BETWEEN 1953 AND 1960 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) > 20 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'N%' AND s.g > 88.37 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1900 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 190 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 2008 AND t.w > 42 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 36 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1955 AND t.year <= 1945 AND s.gp > 5 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3296 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 1913 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 564 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 1907 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3998 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1904 AND t.year <= 1974 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 14 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) FILTER (WHERE ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 2011 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 33 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rate_3yr_rolling DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins, COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) AS playoff_losses FROM teams t LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1945 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) > 15 ORDER BY t.year DESC, playoff_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 26 AND s.pts >= 107 AND t.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 2004 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 367 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 19 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 43 AND s.pts >= 82 AND t.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 2006 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 95 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 57 AND s.pts >= 106 AND t.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1996 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 68 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 9 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1945 AND t.year <= 1927 AND (t.w > 46 OR t.l < 31) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2587 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.w >= 22 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 99 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.w DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1917 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4676 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 2002 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 40 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_lg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid) AS awards_in_year_lg FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 2022 AND t.w > 24 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid, t.pts HAVING SUM(t.g) > 61 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year_by_league, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year > 2008 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 32) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid, t.pts HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 264 ORDER BY total_goals_for DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, ROUND(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0) * 100, 2) AS win_pct FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 56 AND t.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1985 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY win_pct DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid) AS avg_team_player_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1919 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, s.pts ORDER BY t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year >= 1918 AND sp.year <= 1972) AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND t.w >= 9 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.w >= 29 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year UNION ALL SELECT sp.tmidwinner AS tmid, sp.year, COUNT(*) AS total_series_wins, MAX(sp.goalswinner) AS max_goals FROM seriespost sp JOIN teams t ON sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid AND sp.year = t.year WHERE sp.year >= 1941 AND sp.w >= 7 GROUP BY sp.tmidwinner, sp.year ORDER BY total_wins DESC;
