SELECT t.year AS season_year, t.lgid AS league_id, t.tmid AS team_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, MAX(gp.gp) AS max_games_played, MIN(gs.min) AS min_goalie_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN ap.playerid END) AS hart_winners_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.half = 1 THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.half = 2 THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, LAG(SUM(s.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_season_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc gp ON t.year = gp.year AND t.tmid = gp.tmid JOIN goalies gs ON t.year = gs.year AND t.tmid = gs.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN teamshalf sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost ser ON t.year = ser.year AND (t.tmid = ser.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = ser.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid LEFT JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.year = tsc.year AND t.tmid = tsc.tmid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1951 AND t.rank1 <= 7 AND s.gp > 67 AND gp.gp > 89 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1076 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 16 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND ap.year >= 1919 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 2017 AND s.g >= 23 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1906 AND t.year <= 1923 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 1922 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1936 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1940 AND 1980 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2010 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1986 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1484 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1962 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 1901 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND t.year <= 1904 AND s.g > 39 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1926 AND s.g > 54 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1909 AND s.g > 96 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1969 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1995.43 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1950 AND s.g > 15 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1342 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 2016 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (s.gp < 9) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 428 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 2012 AND s.gp > 76 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 119 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 2001 AND s.gp > 47 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 1939 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4633 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 2007 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3030 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1930 AND s.gp > 24 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 201 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1970 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 12 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1982 AND t.year <= 2022 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 45 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS total_teams, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 56 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_teams, SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_ranked_teams, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2006 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.g) > 82 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_teams DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 1917 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 46 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1959 AND t.year <= 1949 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1905 AND t.year <= 2015 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4954 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 1979 AND s.gp > 40 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 41 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1919 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 3 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1909 AND t.year <= 1954 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 415 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 2001 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 346 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.year <= 2006 AND (t.w > 52 OR t.l < 61) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 296 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 46 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2004 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 2019 AND (t.w > 85 OR t.l < 54) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 37 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 1928 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1912 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 42 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 1986 AND s.gp >= 55 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 2006 AND s.gp > 52 AND s.pts > 72 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 234 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 29 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_player, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(g.gp::integer) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(g.w::integer) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(g.l::integer) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(g.sho::integer) AS total_shutouts, AVG(g.ga::numeric / NULLIF(g.gp::numeric, 0)) AS avg_goals_against_per_game, SUM(c.g) AS total_coach_games, SUM(c.w) AS total_coach_wins, SUM(c.l) AS total_coach_losses, AVG(c.w::numeric / NULLIF(c.g::numeric, 0)) AS avg_coach_win_pct, SUM(ts.w) AS total_team_wins, SUM(ts.l) AS total_team_losses, SUM(ts.t) AS total_team_ties, AVG(ts.w::numeric / NULLIF(ts.g::numeric, 0)) AS avg_team_win_pct, SUM(sp.w) AS total_playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS total_playoff_losses, AVG(sp.w::numeric / NULLIF((sp.w + sp.l)::numeric, 0)) AS avg_playoff_win_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches_count, SUM(ap.year) FILTER (WHERE ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS hart_trophy_years_sum, AVG(SUM(s.pts)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_points_4yr, AVG(SUM(ts.w)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins_4yr, AVG(AVG(c.w::numeric / NULLIF(c.g::numeric, 0))) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_coach_win_pct_4yr FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year JOIN awardsmisc am ON t.year = am.year JOIN hof h ON t.year = h.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN combinedshutouts cs ON t.year = cs.year JOIN goaliessc gsc ON t.year = gsc.year AND t.tmid = gsc.tmid JOIN goaliesshootout gso ON t.year = gso.year AND t.tmid = gso.tmid JOIN scoringsc ssc ON t.year = ssc.year AND t.tmid = ssc.tmid JOIN scoringshootout sso ON t.year = sso.year AND t.tmid = sso.tmid JOIN scoringsup sup ON t.year = sup.year JOIN teamsplits tspl ON t.year = tspl.year AND t.tmid = tspl.tmid JOIN teamvsteam tvt ON t.year = tvt.year AND t.tmid = tvt.tmid JOIN teamshalf tsh ON t.year = tsh.year AND t.tmid = tsh.tmid JOIN abbrev a ON t.lgid = a.code WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 1921 AND ts.g >= 93 AND ts.w >= 28 AND s.pts >= 79 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7391 AND SUM(ts.w) > 94 AND AVG(c.w::numeric / NULLIF(c.g::numeric, 0)) > 0.59 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1938 AND t.year <= 1924 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 49 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) < 0.73 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1984 AND t.g > 97 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 120 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Art Ross Trophy') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 11 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE w > 43) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 2 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(*) AS seasons FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1940 AND t.year <= 1966 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 53 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 10 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 81 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Record' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Record' ELSE 'Even Record' END AS record_category, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1922 AND t.year <= 2000 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 84 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Season' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Season' ELSE 'Even Season' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1920 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 79 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1905 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 2 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w) * 100.0) / SUM(t.g), 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf) * 1.0) / SUM(t.ga), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_scorer_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1948 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 43 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 22 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 12 THEN t.tmid END) AS top_ranked_teams_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.pts > 76 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_point_teams_count, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1993 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 42 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, MAX(g.sho) AS max_shutouts, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hall_of_fame_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON s.playerid::character varying = h.hofid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1927 AND s.gp >= 93 AND g.gp >= 75 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1353 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1998 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 271 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, LAG(SUM(t.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_games, SUM(SUM(t.g)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_games FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.year <= 1944 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.g) > 40 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 23 AND t2.w > 27 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 50 AND t2.w > 47 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 53 AND t2.w > 47 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_previous_year, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change, AVG(t1.g) AS avg_games, SUM(t1.gf) AS total_goals_for FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.year >= 1927 AND t1.year <= 1999 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING SUM(t1.gf) > 22 ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w AS w_prev, t2.l AS l_prev, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t1.l - t2.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 17 AND t2.w > 76 AND t1.year >= 1957 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l ORDER BY win_diff DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1959.07 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 2.81 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2008.41 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 1.07 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.award LIKE '%' GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4.83 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS num_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid) AS avg_goals_per_player_in_season_league, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM master m LEFT JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying AND s.year = ap.year AND s.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year AND s.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year AND t.lgid = th.lgid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.tmid = tv.tmid AND t.year = tv.year AND t.lgid = tv.lgid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year AND t.lgid = ts.lgid LEFT JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.tmid = gs.tmid AND s.year = gs.year AND s.lgid = gs.lgid LEFT JOIN scoringsc sc ON s.tmid = sc.tmid AND s.year = sc.year AND s.lgid = sc.lgid WHERE s.year >= 1991 AND s.year <= 1963 AND s.gp >= 28 GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, s.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 631 ORDER BY total_points DESC, s.year ASC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1975 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2019 AND lgid = 'None';
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1988 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2002 AND lgid = 'None';
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2019 ) AND g > 11 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1992 AND s.g >= 75 GROUP BY s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 199 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2014 AND s.g >= 45 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals_per_season, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS percentile_75_points_per_season FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.year <= 2009 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 168 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 103.93 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 52.64 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 47.0 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1989.09 AND s.g > 17.05 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 456.13 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2008.1 AND s.g > 14.02 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2010 AND s.pts > 114 AND s.g >= 32 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1983 AND s.pts > 20 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2000 AND s.pts > 88 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2005 AND s.pts > 75 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 34 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1995 AND s.pts > 65 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2014 AND s.pts > 18 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1980 AND s.pts > 90 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1994 AND s.pts > 87 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2020 AND s.pts > 44 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2010 AND t.w >= 55 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 31 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1988 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 98 AND SUM(s.a) > 123 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 1937 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.pos, ', ' ORDER BY s.pos) AS positions_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1930 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.lastname, ', ' ORDER BY m.lastname) AS hall_of_famers, COUNT(DISTINCT h.hofid) AS hof_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN master m ON t.lgid = m.hofid JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid AND t.year = h.year WHERE t.year >= 1931 AND t.w >= 7 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.hofid) > 3 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp AS goalie_gp, g.w AS goalie_w, g.l AS goalie_l, g.sho AS goalie_sho, g.ga AS goalie_ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid) AS avg_team_pts_per_player, SUM(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid ORDER BY s.pts DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_team_pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS team_pts_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid) AS team_player_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS award_count_this_year, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM teamspost sp WHERE sp.year = s.year AND sp.tmid = s.tmid) AS playoff_wins, (SELECT AVG(ts.gf) FROM teamshalf ts WHERE ts.year = s.year AND ts.tmid = s.tmid) AS avg_goals_per_half FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid LEFT JOIN goalies g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON s.year = th.year AND s.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON s.year = tp.year AND s.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN teamvsteam tv ON s.year = tv.year AND s.tmid = tv.tmid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON s.year = ts.year AND s.tmid = ts.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON s.year = sp.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = s.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = s.tmid) WHERE s.year >= 2001 AND s.year <= 1998 AND s.gp > 67 AND t.rank1 <= 4 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(s.year || '-01-01')) BETWEEN 11 AND 10 OR EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM DATE(s.year || '-01-01')) = 2) GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp, g.w, g.l, g.sho, g.ga, s.playerid, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 188 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, m.firstname AS player_firstname, s.g AS goals_scored, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS total_points, g.sho AS shutouts, c.w AS coach_wins, sp.w AS playoff_wins, AVG(ts.g) AS avg_team_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hart_trophy_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS points_rank_in_year FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN goaliessc g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN teamssc ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 1991 AND (s.pts > 131 OR s.g > 51) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL' AND t.playoff = 'Y') AND (c.w IS NULL OR c.w > 50) AND (g.sho IS NULL OR g.sho > 11) AND (sp.w IS NULL OR sp.w < 13) AND (ap.award IS NULL OR ap.award NOT IN ('Lady Byng Trophy', 'Calder Trophy')) GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.g, s.a, s.pts, g.sho, c.w, sp.w, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 281 AND AVG(ts.g) BETWEEN 73 AND 70 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) <= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, points_rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 1954 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 25 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'N%' AND s.g > 77.33 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND s.g > 95.05 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 1910 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 325 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp > 99 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 249 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1959 AND t.year <= 1906 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 65 ORDER BY t.year, goal_rank;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_points_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_team_goals FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 2002 AND t.w > 20 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.lgid, s.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_team_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, a.award, a.note FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.lgid = a.lgid AND t.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 2005 AND t.w > 38 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, a.award, a.note ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS award_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1948 AND t.w > 64 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) >= 18 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t LEFT JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year = 1932 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.w > 41 AND t.l < 13 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1901 AND m.lastname LIKE 'A' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6652 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.g) > 173 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_pts_3yr, SUM(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS cumulative_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 1968 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 63 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND m.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND t.year >= 1997.57 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6530.79 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 3 AND t.year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2001 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 161 ORDER BY t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid), 0) AS award_players_count, AVG(ts.hw + ts.rw) FILTER (WHERE ts.hw IS NOT NULL AND ts.rw IS NOT NULL) AS avg_split_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON tp.year = sp.year AND (tp.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR tp.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 2020 AND t.w > 78 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) > 7 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, playoff_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1993 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7496 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year AS season_year, t.lgid AS league_id, t.tmid AS team_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, MAX(gp.gp) AS max_games_played, MIN(gs.min) AS min_goalie_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN ap.playerid END) AS hart_winners_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.half = 1 THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.half = 2 THEN sp.w ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, LAG(SUM(s.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_season_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc gp ON t.year = gp.year AND t.tmid = gp.tmid JOIN goalies gs ON t.year = gs.year AND t.tmid = gs.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND t.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN teamshalf sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost ser ON t.year = ser.year AND (t.tmid = ser.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = ser.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid LEFT JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.year = tsc.year AND t.tmid = tsc.tmid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 1943 AND t.rank1 <= 19 AND s.gp > 89 AND gp.gp > 31 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1477 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 2010 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN teams t ON ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.year >= 1941 AND t.w >= 21 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN teams t ON ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.year >= 2018 AND t.w >= 65 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1906 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1974 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9423 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1979 AND s.pts > 185 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1955 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1940 AND s.pts > 87 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1963 AND s.pts > 60 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3311 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1909 AND s.g >= 96 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 1968 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 264 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1911 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1922 AND t.year <= 1927 AND s.g > 49 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1937 AND s.g >= 33 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 1952 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 2005 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 423 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1961 AND t.year <= 1901 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 30) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3262 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1921 AND s.gp > 100 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 2015 AND s.gp > 23 AND s.year >= 2010 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4468 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1974 AND s.gp >= 47 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9267 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 2014 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 2014 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2035 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 1937 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 81 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 2001 AND s.gp >= 55 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 45 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1959 AND s.gp > 71 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 249 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1945 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 31 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 1960 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 819 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1953 AND t.year <= 1987 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (s.g > 15 OR s.a > 24) AND NOT (ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3927 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp > 72 AND s.pts > 69 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 116 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1951 AND s.gp >= 48 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1998 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 380 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 2013 AND s.gp > 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 492 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins_split, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses_split, LAG(SUM(t.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 1952 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 62 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS win_rank_in_lg FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1973 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 46 ORDER BY t.lgid, win_rank_in_lg;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins_per_team, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(SUM(t.w)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_wins_per_lg FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1947 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 32 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1998 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1961 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1913 AND t.year <= 1962 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 89 ORDER BY t.year, win_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 1978 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 17 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 36 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w) * 100.0) / SUM(t.g), 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf) * 1.0) / SUM(t.ga), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_scorer_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1944 AND 1977 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 23 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 58 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w)::numeric / SUM(t.g)::numeric) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf)::numeric / SUM(t.ga)::numeric), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1994 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) >= 48 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, goals_ratio DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1998 AND s.gp >= 42 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4252 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 2016 AND t.w > 84 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 66 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against, SUM(t.gf) - SUM(t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC, SUM(t.gf) - SUM(t.ga) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1961 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 79 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_rate, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS rank_by_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND t.year <= 1959 AND t.g > 29 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 15 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.96 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_by_wins ASC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 22 AND t2.w > 36 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 60 AND t2.w > 54 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 41 AND t2.l < 13 AND t1.year >= 1982 AND t2.year <= 2010 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 49 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 64 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 12 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 26 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 54 AND t2.l < 34 AND t1.g >= 79 AND t2.g >= 68 AND t1.year >= 1990 AND t2.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 97 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 74 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 27 AND t2.w > 27 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS combined_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 11 AND t2.w > 12 AND t1.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1972 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 119 ORDER BY combined_wins DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1997 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2010.37 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 3.0 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' ) GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY award_count DESC, ap.year DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' ) GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ORDER BY award_count DESC, ap.year DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(*) > 7.11 ) GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(h.year) AS latest_hof_year FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying JOIN awardsplayers a ON m.playerid::character varying = a.playerid::character varying AND s.year = a.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE s.year >= 1919 AND s.year <= 1987 AND s.gp >= 64 AND a.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, latest_hof_year DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT m.playerid, m.lastname, m.firstname, sq.total_points, sq.total_goals, sq.total_assists FROM master m JOIN ( SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1934 GROUP BY s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3050 ) sq ON m.playerid::character varying = sq.playerid::character varying WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = sq.playerid AND ap.year IN ( SELECT ap2.year FROM awardsplayers ap2 WHERE ap2.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) ) ORDER BY sq.total_points DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1985 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2010 AND lgid = 'None';
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1998 ) AND pts > 147 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1999 AND s.g >= 73 GROUP BY s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 106 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2020 AND s.g >= 73 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 47.0 AND s.a > 37.22 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 41.92 OR s.pts > 82.95 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 199.97 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1989.18 AND 2017.74 AND s.gp > 46.4 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 31.33 AND t.l < 16.07 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 308.53 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 64.52 AND s.a > 71.08 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 40.02 OR s.pts > 77.87 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 294.28 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1980.23 AND 2003.26 AND s.gp > 65.4 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 47.11 AND t.l < 20.73 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 408.68 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals_per_season, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS percentile_75_points_per_season FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1982 AND s.year <= 1931 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 894 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 5 AND t.w > 59 AND s.year >= 2000 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 24 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 81.25 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 64.9 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 42.25 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2010.88 AND s.g > 26.93 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 224.45 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1999 AND s.g > 35 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.g > 17 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 23 AND l < 12 ) AND s.g > 33 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 26 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 26 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 36 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 19 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 50.23 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 13.13 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 65.84 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 31.99 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
