SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 66.84 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 9.67 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND s.pts > 70 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.pts > 92 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1999.25 AND s.pts > 84.73 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 23 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1984 AND s.pts > 94 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid ORDER BY s.g DESC) AS rank_by_goals_by_league, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.lgid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts_by_league, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1994 AND s.pts > 17 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 10 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, s.lgid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 79 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.pts > 5 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS percentile_75_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid WHERE s.g > 16 AND t.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1995 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 27 ORDER BY s.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.a) AS median_assists, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.lgid = t.lgid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1960 AND s.year <= 1938 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 100 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(h.year) AS latest_hof_year FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1971 AND s.gp > 58 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.playerid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 965 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year IN ( SELECT year FROM ( SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Lady Byng Memorial Trophy' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(*) > 31 ) AS sub ) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(s.pts) > 37 ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND s.g > 33.82 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND s.g > 73.08 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1982 AND t.year <= 1959 AND (t.w > 84 OR t.l < 28) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 439 AND AVG(t.g) < 96 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1946 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9484 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, a.award, a.note FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.lgid = a.lgid AND t.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1994 AND t.w > 68 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, a.award, a.note ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 92 AND s.pts >= 66 AND t.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1999 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 372 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_awarded_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1905 AND t.w > 67 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 14 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_awarded_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 1914 AND t.w > 25 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS award_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.w > 42 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) >= 10 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1944 AND t.year <= 1917 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3885 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 2003 AND t.w > 20 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 232 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, MAX(g.sho) AS max_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.lgid = s.lgid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid AND t.lgid = g.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1914 AND t.year <= 1946 AND t.rank1 <= 4 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 25 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.w > 52 AND t.l < 27 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 2006 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3771 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 2001 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2809 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 2009 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 979 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 2003 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 735 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year >= 2011 AND sp.year <= 2017) AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND t.w >= 32 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_pts_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 50 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, s.pts, t.lgid ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid, t.year) AS avg_player_pts, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1995 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, s.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, SUM(ts.g) AS total_games_last_30_days, AVG(ts.w::numeric / NULLIF(ts.g, 0)) AS win_rate_last_30_days FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid AND t.lgid = tv.lgid WHERE th.half = 2 AND ts.year >= 2007 AND tp.year >= 1982 AND tv.year >= 1972 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(ts.g) > 81 ORDER BY win_rate_last_30_days DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1997 AND t.w > 36 AND s.gp > 46 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.g) > 325 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 30 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN teams t ON ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.year >= 1992 AND t.w > 35 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1909 AND t.year <= 1916 AND s.pts > 45 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1903 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1211 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 1957 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 1990 AND s.pts > 138 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.year <= 1956 AND s.pts > 199 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 1995 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 1987 AND s.gp > 17 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 190 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 1991 AND s.gp > 52 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 207 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1938 AND s.gp > 48 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2757 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 1982 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3447 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1958 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 2018 AND s.gp > 41 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 157 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(gp.gp::integer) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid JOIN goaliessc gp ON g.playerid = gp.playerid AND g.year = gp.year WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.year <= 2011 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 27 AND SUM(s.pts) > 7821 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1935 AND 1977 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1921 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 33 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 2008 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 35 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1915 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 1985 AND s.pts > 193 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 14 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1968 AND s.gp > 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 346 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 1983 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1946 AND t.year <= 1944 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 143 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 1978 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 442 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1912 AND t.year <= 1993 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 12) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 443 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 36 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1933 AND t.g > 23 AND s.gp > 37 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3386 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(t.g AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(t.w, 0)) AS avg_goals_per_win, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, SUM(COALESCE(gp.gp, 0)) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(COALESCE(gs.gp, 0)) AS total_scoring_games, ROUND(AVG(SUM(s.pts)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_points_3yr FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goaliessc gp ON t.year = gp.year AND t.tmid = gp.tmid LEFT JOIN scoringsc gs ON t.year = gs.year AND t.tmid = gs.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 2011 AND t.g > 86 AND s.gp > 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.g, t.w HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9301 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 10 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 1936 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 32 AND AVG(t.w) >= 16 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins_split, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses_split, LAG(SUM(t.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 2015 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 30 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.t) AS total_ties, SUM(t.gf) AS goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS goals_against, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_player_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_player_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, SUM(s.pim) AS total_player_pim, SUM(gp.gp) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(gp.w) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(gp.l) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(gp.t) AS total_goalie_ties, SUM(gp.ga) AS total_goalie_ga, SUM(gp.sho) AS total_goalie_shutouts, SUM(c.g) AS coach_games, SUM(c.w) AS coach_wins, SUM(c.l) AS coach_losses, SUM(c.t) AS coach_ties, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_losses, SUM(sp.t) AS playoff_ties, SUM(sp.gf) AS playoff_gf, SUM(sp.ga) AS playoff_ga FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc gp ON t.year = gp.year AND t.tmid = gp.tmid JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid JOIN teamspost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1916 AND t.year <= 1925 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 100 AND SUM(t.w) > 9 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(SUM(t.w)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.w >= 76 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 28 ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(*) AS seasons_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 2001 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 28 AND AVG(t.g) >= 23 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 1912 AND t.w > 53 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 27 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1979 AND 1960 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 22 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) AND sp.round = 'P' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1965 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 50 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(*) AS seasons FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 2001 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 59 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 25 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS win_rank_in_lg FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1959 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 90 ORDER BY t.lgid, win_rank_in_lg;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins_per_team, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(SUM(t.w)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_wins_per_lg FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1931 AND t.year <= 1923 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 56 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1954 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1934 AND t.year <= 1990 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1923 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_rank_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.playoff = 'Y' THEN t.year END) AS playoff_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 1991 AND t.g >= 35 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 14 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, SUM(g.sho) AS total_shutouts, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1908 AND t.year <= 1916 AND t.w > 66 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 79 AND SUM(s.pts) > 1323 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1967 AND t.year <= 1972 AND t.g > 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 10 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS teams_last_4_years FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.w > 60 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, t.w ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2002 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 30 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 41 AND t2.w > 33 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS w1, t2.w AS w2, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid != t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 60 AND t2.w > 40 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1931 AND 1958 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_diff DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS w1, t2.w AS w2, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid != t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 70 AND t2.w > 64 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1998 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_diff DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 17 AND t2.w > 37 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 44 AND t2.w > 80 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t1.gf) AS avg_gf_t1, AVG(t2.gf) AS avg_gf_t2 FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid != t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 0 AND t2.w > 76 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1958 AND 2023 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 141 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t1.year ASC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 2.34 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1983 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2019 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 1982 AND s.g > 38 AND t.w > 21 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 2005 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 500 AND SUM(s.a) > 386 AND COUNT(*) >= 16 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 1999 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2014 AND s.g > 49 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 122.13 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 63.92 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 43.15 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1981.8 AND s.g > 17.98 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 352.91 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 127.22 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 59.93 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 35.07 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2005.67 AND s.g > 9.58 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 445.82 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.pts > 70 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 51 AND s.pts > 56 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 9 AND g.gp::integer > 29 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1996 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 123 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1946 AND s.gp >= 58 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 462 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING t.w > 11.95 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 1908 AND (t.w > 56 OR t.l < 57) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4051 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1982 AND t.year <= 2004 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 1966 AND s.pts > 13 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1938 AND t.year <= 1947 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1990 AND s.gp > 56 AND s.year >= 2012 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4280 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1954 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 73 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 2016 AND s.gp > 63 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 50 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 39 AND t2.w > 44 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 19 AND t2.w > 47 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 22 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 37 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1990 AND s.pts > 115 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 1933 AND s.gp > 71 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 408 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 1991 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 379 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 23 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 2012 AND s.g > 75 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 157 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.w DESC, t.l ASC) AS team_rank_in_year FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1902 AND t.year <= 1990 AND t.w > 57 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.51 ORDER BY win_pct DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN teams t ON ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.year >= 1958 AND t.w > 20 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1944 AND s.g >= 28 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(gp.gp::integer) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid JOIN goaliessc gp ON g.playerid = gp.playerid AND g.year = gp.year WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 2007 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 18 AND SUM(s.pts) > 8919 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 1947 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1953 AND t.year <= 1922 AND s.gp >= 73 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3717 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.year <= 1950 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 407 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins_split, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses_split, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_player_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_player_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.lgid = s.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1948 AND t.g > 19 AND t.gf > 100 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 86 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.36 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goal_differential DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 29 AND t2.w > 81 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 1993) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.p_id = s.playerid WHERE s.year >= 1998 AND s.g > 100 GROUP BY m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY award_count DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1985 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2002 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 41 AND t.w > 33 AND s.year >= 2008 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 17 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 1989 AND s.g >= 41 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1996 AND s.pts > 57 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1986.39 AND s.pts > 82.3 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.pts > 86 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1983 AND s.pts > 27 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1990 AND s.pts > 76 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.a) AS median_assists, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.lgid = t.lgid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1944 AND s.year <= 1902 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 413 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING t.w > 42.48 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(ts.hw + ts.hl + ts.ht) AS avg_home_games, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 2012 AND t.pts > 151 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 7 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.w > 42 AND t.l < 13 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC) AS league_rank, LAG(t.pts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1946 AND 1937 AND t.pts > 157 AND s.gp > 16 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 367 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1904 AND t.year <= 1977 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1997 AND (t.w > 79 OR t.l < 22) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4976 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1977.76 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND s.g >= 43 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1972 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1925 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3858 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 1939 AND s.gp > 56 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3881 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 2022 AND s.gp > 57 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 440 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins_per_team FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 2006 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 25 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 1921 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 3 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1939 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4680 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1946 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 10 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3861 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Art Ross Trophy') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 23 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 2019 AND s.gp >= 37 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 333 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 20 AND t2.l < 25 AND t1.year >= 1990 AND t2.year <= 1998 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 60 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 31 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 16 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 22 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 69.53 AND s.a > 41.04 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 27.04 AND s.pts >= 68.72 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 145.37 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 5.9 AND s.a < 6.45 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1988.31 AND 2009.51 AND s.g >= 24.97 AND s.pts > 51.26 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 182.2 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 95.89 AND AVG(s.pts) > 55.36 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 34 AND s.pts > 129 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 1 AND g.gp::integer > 24 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2003 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 2004 AND s.gp >= 39 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 913 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(CAST(s.pts AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(s.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS team_goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 2004 AND s.gp > 58 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.p_id, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 452 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, team_name;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 1965 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 639 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.w > 27 AND t.l < 14 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND s.g >= 49 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 2004 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1952 AND t.year <= 2008 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 459 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Record' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Record' ELSE 'Even Record' END AS record_category, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1965 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 93 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 1985) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.p_id = s.playerid WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.g > 82 GROUP BY m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY award_count DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1990 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2007 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1998.24 AND s.pts > 112.54 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2007 AND s.g >= 26 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((s.year), (s.tmid), (s.year, s.tmid)) ORDER BY s.year, s.tmid;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 1980 AND s.gp > 81 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 598 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 1926 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 917 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 1989 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t.w > 52 OR t.rank1 <= 5) AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 15 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) < 0.55 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 2020 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.w < 37 AND t.l > 62) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 20 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) < 0.93 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1911 AND t.year <= 1916 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 77 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1981 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.32 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC) AS rank_in_year FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 55 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(th.gf) > 201 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_in_year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored_by_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND m.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND t.year >= 1973.4 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 340.08 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_scored_by_players DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_pts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS num_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 2005 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING AVG(s.pts) > 48.87 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, avg_player_pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 2002 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 2012 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4626 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1962 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND s.g >= 30 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2001 AND t.year <= 1940 AND s.gp > 39 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 341 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1974 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4608 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 1970 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 499 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1914 AND 2000 AND t.g > 77 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND m.birthyear::integer > 1950 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 483 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.w > 29 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 54 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 15 AND t2.w > 71 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 60.05 AND s.a > 67.49 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 26.72 OR s.pts > 101.84 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 190.61 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1982.2 AND 2008.81 AND s.gp > 48.08 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 55.68 AND t.l < 10.55 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 614.35 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1980.11 AND s.g > 71.09 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1988 AND s.pts > 90 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 62 AND s.pts > 45 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 9 AND g.gp::integer > 43 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2001 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2014 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 34 AND SUM(s.a) > 111 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(h.year) AS latest_hof_year FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1923 AND s.gp > 94 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.tmid, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 848 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.year <= 1981 AND s.gp > 13 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 241 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_points_rank;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, m.firstname AS player_firstname, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp AS goalie_gp, g.w AS goalie_w, g.l AS goalie_l, g.sho AS goalie_sho, c.g AS coach_g, c.w AS coach_w, c.l AS coach_l, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, t.lgid) AS avg_pts_per_lg_year, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_goals_running, COUNT(a.award) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank_year, (s.g * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.gp, 0)) AS goals_per_game_pct FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN teams t ON s.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND s.tmid = t.tmid LEFT JOIN goaliessc g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON m.coachid = c.c_id AND s.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.pk_id = th.year_tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.pk_id = tp.year_tmid AND t.year = tp.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE s.year >= 2020 AND s.year <= 1911 AND s.gp > 86 AND t.year >= 1909 AND t.year <= 1938 AND th.half = 2 AND tp.g > 1 AND sp.round = 'P' GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp, g.w, g.l, g.sho, c.g, c.w, c.l, t.lgid, s.playerid, a.award HAVING SUM(s.g) > 96 AND AVG(s.pts) > 68 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1965 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7534 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
