SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 2020 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(s.pts) > (SELECT AVG(pts) FROM scoring WHERE year = 1985) ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 2004 AND s.gp > 45 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 147 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1919 AND t.w > 18 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1715 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1983 AND t.w > 30 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 629 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 1995 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 16 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 28 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.year FROM scoring s WHERE s.g > 16) AND t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 2022 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.w > 0) AND t.w > 27 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1906 AND s.g >= 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1927 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 2019 AND s.gp > 39 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 377 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 2012 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.year <= 1950 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 271 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 2003 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_player, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(g.gp) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(g.w) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(g.l) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(g.t) AS total_goalie_ties, AVG(g.ga) AS avg_goals_against_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS player_award_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_award_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.hofid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hall_of_fame_inductees, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, LAG(SUM(s.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, SUM(SUM(s.pts)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.lgid AND t.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON t.year = h.year AND t.lgid = h.category JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamsplits tsp ON t.year = tsp.year AND t.tmid = tsp.tmid JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1991 AND t.rank1 <= 11 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3236 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 36 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins_split, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses_split, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_player_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_player_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.lgid = s.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1946 AND t.year <= 2014 AND t.g > 11 AND t.gf > 286 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 471 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.93 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goal_differential DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1934 AND t.year <= 1969 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1961 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 33 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 55 AND t2.w > 25 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 18 AND t2.w > 7 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 62 AND t2.w > 49 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1952 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.award LIKE '%' GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 9.11 ORDER BY distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.g > 39 AND t.w > 54 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1988 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 22) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 476 AND SUM(s.a) > 680 AND COUNT(*) >= 17 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.pts > 116 AND s.g >= 19 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1982 AND s.pts > 70 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2009 AND s.pts > 33 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1968 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(gs.gp AS INTEGER)) AS avg_games_played, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1973 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 70 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 600 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_points_rank;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS team_goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 2008 AND s.gp > 10 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.p_id, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 3 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, team_name, player_lastname;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.g) AS avg_player_goals, SUM(s.pts) AS total_team_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1951 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hof h WHERE h.hofid = m.hofid AND h.year <= 2002 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2741 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year_by_league, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year > 2001 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 98) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid, t.pts HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 408 ORDER BY total_goals_for DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 43 AND t.year BETWEEN 1918 AND 1947 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 164 ORDER BY t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year >= 1962 AND sp.year <= 1947) ORDER BY t.year DESC, goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_pts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS num_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1975 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING AVG(s.pts) > 66.18 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, avg_player_pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1908 AND (t.w > 28 OR t.l < 26) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4325 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND s.g >= 61 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 2010 AND s.gp > 69 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 144 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 2008 AND s.gp > 32 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 799 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 1976 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 35 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1948 AND t.year <= 1948 AND t.g > 74 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 489 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1931 AND s.gp >= 35 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w) * 100.0) / SUM(t.g), 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf) * 1.0) / SUM(t.ga), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_scorer_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1939 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 17 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 45 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_wins DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 38 AND t2.w > 23 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 0 AND t2.w > 23 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1975.89 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1993 ) AND pts > 136 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2012 ) AND g > 27 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1988 AND s.g >= 100 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.g > 48 AND t.w > 44 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1982 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 34) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 328 AND SUM(s.a) > 351 AND COUNT(*) >= 8 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.pts > 55 AND s.g >= 10 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1996 AND s.pts > 67 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1986.97 AND s.pts > 102.46 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1984 AND s.pts > 98 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.pts > 49 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.tmid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_in_year, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid) AS avg_team_pts, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_goals_3yr FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1985 AND s.pts > 103 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 29 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.a) > 39 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, MIN(gp.gp) AS min_games_played, MAX(gp.gp) AS max_games_played, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN goaliessc gp ON s.playerid = gp.playerid AND s.year = gp.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 1988 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 37 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.lgid, s.pos), (t.lgid), ()) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4552 ORDER BY t.lgid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND s.g > 71.58 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1966 AND s.gp > 67 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 230 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1901 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3238 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING t.w > 18 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins, COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) AS playoff_losses FROM teams t LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1964 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) > 3 ORDER BY t.year DESC, playoff_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalties FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 10 AND t.year >= 2020 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 55 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalties FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 34 AND t.year >= 2010 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 167 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1986 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 20 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1921 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.25 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1996 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1365 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 1991 AND t.g > 96 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.ga, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 316 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.year FROM scoring s WHERE s.gp > 27) AND t.w > 76 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.playerid IS NOT NULL) AS star_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.pts >= 132 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, t.g, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 487 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 1958 AND s.pts > 95 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.year <= 1939 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 31 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1985 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2011 AND s.gp > 35 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 198 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 1978 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1950 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 92 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN master m ON a.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 1921 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 41 ORDER BY t.year DESC, unique_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.tmid, ', ' ORDER BY t.tmid) AS team_list, COUNT(*) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1939 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 5 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2004 AND 1950 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 334 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goals_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1951 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 5) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 494 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 81 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 18 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1938 AND t.year <= 1969 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 82 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_against ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1969 AND s.gp > 41 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 353 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1953 AND t.year <= 1985 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 28 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(SUM(t.w)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.w >= 35 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 73 ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 2013 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 12 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1902 AND t.year <= 1904 AND s.gp >= 36 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1957 AND s.gp > 83 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 37 AND t2.l < 19 AND t1.g >= 75 AND t2.g >= 67 AND t1.year >= 1980 AND t2.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 76 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 26 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 80 AND t2.w > 24 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_previous_year, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 51 AND t2.w > 25 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_current, t2.w AS wins_previous, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year + 1 AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 32 AND t2.w > 36 AND t1.year >= 1942 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS combined_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 8 AND t2.w > 14 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1975 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.tmid, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 26 ORDER BY combined_wins DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 2020 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2009.19 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 34 AND t.w > 27 AND s.year >= 1993 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 25 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.pts > 48 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2000 AND s.pts > 16 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1997 AND s.pts > 74 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1984 AND s.pts > 70 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 73 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1987 AND s.g >= 43 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((s.year), (s.tmid), (s.year, s.tmid)) ORDER BY s.year, s.tmid;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.g >= 37 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((s.year), (s.tmid), (s.year, s.tmid)) ORDER BY s.year, s.tmid;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points_per_player, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS percentile_75_goals FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.year <= 1946 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4127 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 2000 AND t.g >= 26 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 138 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1922 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 101 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1952 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 141 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 38 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 2012 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 332 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 1923 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t.w > 23 OR t.rank1 <= 5) AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y' AND t.g < 98) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 710 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1901 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4059 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points, SUM(g.sho) AS total_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN goaliessc g ON t.tmid = g.tmid AND t.year = g.year WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1967 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(g.sho) > 33 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 73 AND s.pts >= 141 AND t.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1997 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 125 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1908 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 22) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 30 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 29 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1944 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 99 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.pts) AS total_points, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(g.sho::integer) AS total_shutouts, AVG(g.ga::numeric) AS avg_goals_against, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_losses, SUM(tsh.w) AS first_half_wins, SUM(tsh.l) AS first_half_losses, SUM(tsh2.w) AS second_half_wins, SUM(tsh2.l) AS second_half_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN t.year >= 2018 THEN t.w ELSE 0 END) AS recent_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN t.year >= 2007 THEN t.l ELSE 0 END) AS recent_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, LAG(SUM(t.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, SUM(t.pts) - LAG(SUM(t.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS points_change FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid JOIN teamspost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmid JOIN teamshalf tsh ON t.year = tsh.year AND t.tmid = tsh.tmid AND tsh.half = 1 JOIN teamshalf tsh2 ON t.year = tsh2.year AND t.tmid = tsh2.tmid AND tsh2.half = 2 JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid JOIN seriespost sr ON t.year = sr.year AND (t.tmid = sr.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sr.tmidloser) JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1945 AND t.rank1 <= 8 AND s.gp >= 68 AND g.gp >= 65 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 62 AND SUM(t.l) < 94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year AS team_year, t.lgid AS league_id, t.tmid AS team_id, s.playerid AS scoring_player_id, g.playerid AS goalie_player_id, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year_tmid) AS seasons_played, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_season, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(CASE WHEN g.gp IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.gp AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(CASE WHEN g.w IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.w AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.l IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.l AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN g.sho IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.sho AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_shutouts, AVG(CASE WHEN g.ga IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.ga AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_goals_against, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards, MAX(t.rank1) AS best_team_rank, SUM(t.w) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_team_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_team_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_win_rank, LAG(SUM(t.w), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS previous_year_wins, SUM(t.w) - LAG(SUM(t.w), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS win_change_from_previous FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid AND s.playerid = g.playerid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON m.coachid = ac.coachid AND t.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 2015 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(t.year || '-01-01')) BETWEEN 5 AND 2 OR t.year % 4 = 0) AND s.g >= 35 AND s.a >= 94 AND (CASE WHEN g.ga IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.ga AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) <= 126 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.playerid, g.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.year_tmid) >= 13 AND SUM(CASE WHEN g.w IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.w AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) >= 184 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_win_rank ASC LIMIT 745;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND a.year <= 1948 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1930 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1912 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1959 AND t.year <= 2012 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 75 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1908 AND t.year <= 1909 AND s.g >= 47 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3620 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1957 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1945 AND t.year <= 2014 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 2018 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 41 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1908 AND t.year <= 1952 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 303 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.year <= 2021 AND s.gp > 83 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3487 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 2010 AND s.gp > 29 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 98 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp > 28 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 413 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.w > 73 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 142 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1973 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 2021 AND s.gp > 73 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 30 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 2015 AND (t.w > 42 OR t.l < 7) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 438 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 12 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 1999 AND t.w > 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4579 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(CASE WHEN s.pos = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defensemen_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (s.g > 44 OR s.pts > 17) AND NOT (s.pim < 200) AND ap.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 458 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 2022 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1917 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2963 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1924 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3288 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1963 AND t.g > 36 AND s.gp > 91 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 205 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1922 AND t.year <= 1912 AND t.g > 99 AND s.gp > 23 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 165 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 1 THEN t.tmid END) AS top_ranked_teams, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2016 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 37 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_against ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1923 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 61 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 2001 AND t.w > 44 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1382 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 2010 AND t.w > 86 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2861 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf) - SUM(t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY (SUM(t.w) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.g), 0)) DESC) AS league_win_pct_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 2004 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goal_differential DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 46 AND t2.w > 43 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 53 AND t2.l < 21 AND t1.year >= 1993 AND t2.year <= 2009 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 73 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 45 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 19 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 11 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 45 AND t2.w > 55 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS w1, t2.w AS w2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid != t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 35 AND t2.w > 25 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1976 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS w1, t2.w AS w2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 5 AND t2.w > 71 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1966 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 148 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_current, t2.w AS wins_previous, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year + 1 AND t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 49 AND t2.w > 4 AND t1.year >= 1942 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1996 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2004 AND lgid = 'None';
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2010 ) AND g > 61 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2018 ) AND g > 33 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 48.44 AND s.a > 77.42 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 47.31 AND s.pts >= 76.83 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 176.96 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 14.78 AND s.a < 14.87 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1985.99 AND 1995.3 AND s.g >= 11.39 AND s.pts > 30.36 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 115.68 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 73.01 AND AVG(s.pts) > 81.42 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2000 AND s.pts > 133 AND s.g >= 48 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2000 AND s.pts > 53 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1990 AND s.gp >= 36 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 115 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 2012 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, m.firstname AS player_firstname, s.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.pts > 110 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_point_seasons, SUM(CASE WHEN s.gp < 17 THEN s.g ELSE 0 END) AS goals_in_low_gp_seasons, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_player_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN teams t ON s.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND s.tmid = t.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.year_tmid = gs.year_tmid JOIN teamshalf th ON s.year_tmid = th.year_tmid AND s.year = th.year JOIN teamvsteam tv ON s.year_tmid = tv.year_tmid AND s.year = tv.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 2000 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.year, s.tmid, s.pts, s.gp HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 71 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 ORDER BY team_player_rank, s.year DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 2003 AND s.g >= 9 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 517 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1970 AND s.g > 31 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 131 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins, COALESCE(SUM(sp.l), 0) AS playoff_losses FROM teams t LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1941 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING t.w > 26 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 20 AND s.pts >= 119 AND t.year BETWEEN 1989 AND 1999 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 422 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 74 AND s.pts >= 166 AND t.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 2004 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 276 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalties FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 39 AND t.year >= 2013 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 50 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 1974 AND t.g > 34 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 18 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.66 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2005 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 68 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 1 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.year <= 1976 AND t.w > 84 AND s.g > 0 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2899 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 12 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC) AS rank_by_pts FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE playerid = 2206) AND t.pts > 82 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, th.half HAVING SUM(th.g) > 67 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_by_pts;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) < 13 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1964 AND s.pts > 117 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1944 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 2003 AND s.g > 11 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 8648 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1919 AND s.g >= 92 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1909 AND s.gp > 62 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4447 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1991 AND s.gp > 17 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 346 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (s.g > 86 OR s.a > 77) AND NOT (ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1178 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 2010 AND s.gp >= 59 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 8 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1996 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 288 ORDER BY total_goals_for DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid) AS awards_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1998 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > (SELECT AVG(w) FROM teams WHERE year = t.year AND lgid = t.lgid) ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1965 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 9 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w) * 100.0) / SUM(t.g), 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf) * 1.0) / SUM(t.ga), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1954 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 4 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1947 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hof h WHERE h.hofid = m.hofid AND h.category = 'Player') GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(t.w) > 99 ORDER BY award_players_count DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 27 AND l < 8 ) AND s.g > 23 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.pts > 72 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.pts > 52 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND s.g >= 24 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1922 AND t.year <= 1951 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 2023 AND s.gp >= 10 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 318 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 2011 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g > 48 AND s.pts > 37 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 30 AND SUM(s.pts) > 4540 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.lgid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 76.93 AND t2.w > 42.78 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.lgid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
