SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 2018.9 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2014 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2008.48 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 3.46 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2015.21 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 2.08 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2019.95 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 4.01 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1996 ) AND pts > 25 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 48.81 AND s.a > 43.69 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 40.09 OR s.pts > 91.75 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 285.35 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1996.78 AND 2005.77 AND s.gp > 59.09 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 51.9 AND t.l < 11.18 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 689.68 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND s.pts > 23 AND s.g >= 18 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 1980 AND s.g >= 41 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 23 AND l < 9 ) AND s.g > 43 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1985 AND s.pts > 102 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2007 AND s.pts > 66 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 21 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2019 AND s.pts > 42 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.tmid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_in_year, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid) AS avg_team_pts, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_goals_3yr FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1998 AND s.pts > 26 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 46 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.a) > 106 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2018 AND t.w >= 20 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 59 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.a) AS median_assists, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.lgid = t.lgid WHERE s.year >= 2009 AND s.year <= 1966 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 518 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.w > 68 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 2004 AND s.gp > 70 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 52 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name, player_name;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_game, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year) AS seasons_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1959 AND t.year <= 1983 AND s.g > 93 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 303 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(CAST(s.pts AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(s.gp, 0)) AS avg_points_per_game, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS team_goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 2004 AND s.gp > 66 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.p_id, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 132 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, team_name;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1922.38 AND a.award LIKE '%Hart%' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3608.36 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2005.82 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 400.24 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year AS season, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS hart_trophy_winners_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid LEFT JOIN goaliessc gs ON t.year = gs.year AND t.tmid = gs.tmid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1913 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 72 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > (SELECT AVG(pts) * 1.5 FROM scoring WHERE year = t.year AND lgid = t.lgid) AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, unique_players ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE rank1 <= 19) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 72 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 2002 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t.w > 34 OR t.rank1 <= 30) AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y' AND t.g < 29) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 211 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year_by_league FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 52 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid, t.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_scorer FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2019 AND t.w > 0 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 257 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1971 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 36 AND t.w < 68) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 30 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1978 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.66 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND t.year <= 2009 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6584 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid) AS avg_team_player_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1997 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, s.pts ORDER BY t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.year FROM scoring s WHERE s.gp > 5) AND t.w > 3 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year) AS avg_win_pct_by_league_year FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teamspost tp WHERE tp.tmid = t.tmid AND tp.year = t.year AND tp.w > 1 ) AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, t.g, t.lgid ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC) AS league_rank, LAG(t.pts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1903 AND t.pts > 198 AND s.gp > 27 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 364 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, SUM(ts.g) AS total_games_last_30_days, AVG(ts.w::numeric / NULLIF(ts.g, 0)) AS win_rate_last_30_days FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid AND t.lgid = tv.lgid WHERE th.half = 1 AND ts.year >= 1980 AND tp.year >= 1972 AND tv.year >= 1985 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name HAVING SUM(ts.g) > 81 ORDER BY win_rate_last_30_days DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.lgid, t.name FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.w > 38 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.lgid, t.name UNION SELECT tp.tmid, tp.year, tp.w, tp.l, tp.g, tp.gf AS pts, tp.lgid, a.fullname AS name FROM teamspost tp JOIN abbrev a ON tp.lgid = a.code WHERE tp.year >= 1964 AND tp.w > 23 GROUP BY tp.tmid, tp.year, tp.w, tp.l, tp.g, tp.gf, tp.lgid, a.fullname ORDER BY year DESC, pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1970 AND s.pts > 149 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 2022 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 1900 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 8428 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 1958 AND s.pts > 73 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1945 AND t.year <= 1970 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 2013 AND s.gp > 27 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 57 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND s.g >= 78 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 1964 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 334 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 1912 AND s.g >= 61 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 37 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top3_finishes, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games_played, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(CASE WHEN s.pts > 125 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_scorers_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 1993 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 9 ORDER BY t.year DESC, top3_finishes DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1955 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 46 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.gp > 65 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 16 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1983 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 364 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1922 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 200 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1910 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND NOT (t.w < 79 OR t.l > 30) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 7 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1911 AND t.year <= 1983 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 2002 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 1984 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 60 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 464 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 43 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 2 THEN t.tmid END) AS top_ranked_teams, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 2014 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 21 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_against ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 46 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 4 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1987 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 24 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_against ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1948 AND t.year <= 1907 AND t.w > 63 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4930 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1939 AND t.w > 93 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4577 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND t.year <= 2008 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 20 ORDER BY t.year, win_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1953 AND t.w > 38 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 52 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 2020 AND s.g >= 90 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4107 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 1925 AND s.gp > 48 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1990 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 24 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM hof WHERE year >= 1931 AND year <= 2023) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 87 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 25 AND t2.l < 16 AND t1.year >= 1993 AND t2.year <= 2001 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 55 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 52 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 16 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 13 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 55 AND t2.w > 48 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1988 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS num_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid) AS avg_goals_per_player_in_season_lg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM master m LEFT JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying AND s.year = ap.year AND s.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year AND s.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year AND t.lgid = th.lgid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON c.coachid::character varying = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year AND c.lgid = ac.lgid LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE s.gp > 67.32 AND s.year BETWEEN 1920.87 AND 1935.97 AND t.rank1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 714.97 ORDER BY total_points DESC, s.year ASC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1991 ) AND g > 32 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2001 ) AND pts > 101 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 1989 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1986 AND s.g > 99 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 50 AND t.w > 58 AND s.year >= 2000 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 96 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 103.47 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 59.42 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 37.43 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1988.4 AND s.g > 24.74 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 370.98 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.pts > 74 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2009 AND s.pts > 85 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 43 AND s.pts > 91 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 9 AND g.gp::integer > 51 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 1996 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 2002 AND s.gp >= 77 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 407 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 2022 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 28 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 1989 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 67 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, COUNT(DISTINCT m.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 1960 AND t.w > 61 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.w) > 20.59 ORDER BY avg_wins DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1971 AND t.year <= 1926 AND (t.w > 47 OR t.l < 68) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 2654 AND AVG(t.g) < 44 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1937 AND t.g > 99 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 67 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1922 AND t.year <= 1948 AND s.g > 91 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 33 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7912 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1997 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2844 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.pts, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 2016 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hof h WHERE h.hofid = m.hofid AND h.year >= 2007 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.pts HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 17 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1951 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 86 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 75 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.w > 74 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 70 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3584 ORDER BY win_pct DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year >= 1995 AND sp.year <= 1927) ORDER BY t.year DESC, goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.rank1, t.lgid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1935 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.rank1, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3331 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1990 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4708 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND s.g >= 46 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1994 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 307 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 2012 AND s.gp > 10 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 315 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1968 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(CAST(g.sho AS INTEGER)) AS total_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND t.year <= 1935 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4632 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1995 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 98 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1999 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 247 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 1913 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 405 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN master m ON a.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 2018 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 16 ORDER BY t.year DESC, unique_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1911 AND s.gp >= 1 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 419 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 2022 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3001 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1953 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 489 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1949 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 430 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(CASE WHEN s.pos = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defensemen_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2013 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (s.g > 34 OR s.pts > 68) AND NOT (s.pim < 55) AND ap.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 453 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 51 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 10 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2004 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 34 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_against ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1971 AND 2009 AND t.g > 25 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND m.birthcountry = 'CAN' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 15 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1921 AND 2006 AND t.g > 8 AND s.gp > 43 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 27 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1991 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w)::numeric / SUM(t.g)::numeric) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf)::numeric / SUM(t.ga)::numeric), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1945 AND t.year <= 1982 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) >= 13 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, goals_ratio DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1912 AND t.year <= 1991 AND s.gp >= 29 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_player_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 1969 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 10 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year;

SELECT t1.name AS team_name, t1.lgid AS league, t1.year AS season, SUM(t1.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t1.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t1.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_points_by_scorer, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award = 'Stanley Cup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stanley_cup_awards FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid <> t2.tmid JOIN teams t3 ON t1.year = t3.year AND t1.lgid = t3.lgid AND t1.tmid <> t3.tmid AND t2.tmid <> t3.tmid JOIN scoring s ON t1.year = s.year AND t1.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t1.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE year > 1915 AND year < 2003 GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tmid) > 6) AND t1.w > 0 AND t1.rank1 < 6 AND h.year > 1907 GROUP BY t1.name, t1.lgid, t1.year HAVING SUM(t1.w) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 22 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 51 AND t2.w > 27 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_previous_year, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change, AVG(t1.g) AS avg_games, SUM(t1.gf) AS total_goals_for FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.year >= 1948 AND t1.year <= 2001 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING SUM(t1.gf) > 417 ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1961.88 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 1990 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 1.15 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 2000 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2005 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.pts > 144 AND s.g >= 47 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.pts > 45 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 144 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1988 AND s.pts > 98 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2018 AND s.pts > 24 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2019 AND t.w >= 38 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 35 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1936 AND s.g >= 59 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.pos, ', ' ORDER BY s.pos) AS positions_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1956 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 19 ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 2002 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9747 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 1996 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 30) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 39 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 15 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1931 AND t.rank1 <= 30 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 14 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1994 AND s.g > 76 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 38 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.gp > 32 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 332 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points, SUM(g.sho) AS total_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN goaliessc g ON t.tmid = g.tmid AND t.year = g.year WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 2010 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(g.sho) > 19 ORDER BY avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) FILTER (WHERE ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1997 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 15 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rate_3yr_rolling DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_scorer FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1992 AND t.w > 47 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 237 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 45 AND s.pts >= 170 AND t.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 1998 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 185 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 86 AND s.pts >= 28 AND t.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2004 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 396 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1985 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t.w > 77 OR t.rank1 <= 15) AND NOT (t.playoff = 'Y') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 9 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) < 0.09 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) AS playoff_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 2016 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sp.w), 0) < 7 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1935 AND t.year <= 1937 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers a JOIN teams t ON a.year = t.year AND a.lgid = t.lgid WHERE a.year >= 2004 AND t.w >= 5 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1919 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1987 AND s.g >= 19 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1909 AND s.gp > 45 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 432 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1974 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1926 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 7 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.w > 56 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 473 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.w::numeric) AS median_wins, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.gf::numeric) AS percentile_75_goals_for, AVG(t.ga::numeric) AS avg_goals_against, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND t.year <= 1988 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric) > 1.2 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.tmid, ', ' ORDER BY t.tmid) AS team_list, COUNT(*) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1982 AND t.year <= 2023 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 52 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1902 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 35 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 1949 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 41 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 128 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Even' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 1 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 31 AND t2.l < 39 AND t1.g >= 63 AND t2.g >= 77 AND t1.year >= 1994 AND t2.year <= 1994 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 69 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 53 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 58 AND t2.l < 38 AND t1.g >= 73 AND t2.g >= 81 AND t1.year >= 1987 AND t2.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 100 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 38 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 66.42 AND t2.w > 49.35 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2003 AND ap.award = 'None' );
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2007 AND ap.award = 'None' );
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1994 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2004 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1983 AND s.g >= 95 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2020 AND s.g >= 47 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1998 AND s.g > 26 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 1993 AND s.g >= 24 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1987 AND s.pts > 11 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2019 AND s.pts > 31 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1985 AND s.pts > 92 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2002 AND s.pts > 50 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 2011 AND s.g >= 65 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE(t.year::text || '-01-01')) AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.g AS INTEGER), 0)) AS total_goals, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.a AS INTEGER), 0)) AS total_assists, AVG(COALESCE(CAST(gp.ga AS INTEGER), 0)) FILTER (WHERE gp.ga IS NOT NULL) AS avg_goals_against, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.pts AS INTEGER), 0)) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goaliessc gp ON s.tmid = gp.tmid AND s.year = gp.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 1932 AND COALESCE(CAST(s.g AS INTEGER), 0) > 52 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, season_year) HAVING SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.pts AS INTEGER), 0)) > 354 ORDER BY t.lgid, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(gs.gp AS INTEGER)) AS avg_games_played, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1993 AND s.gp > 49 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.tmid, s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 419 ORDER BY total_points DESC, distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(gs.gp AS INTEGER)) AS avg_games_played, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 2010 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 58 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 29 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_points_rank;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, COUNT(DISTINCT m.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 1948 AND t.w > 33 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.w) > 58.2 ORDER BY avg_wins DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) AS award_years, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.lgid = a.lgid AND t.year = a.year WHERE t.w > 79 AND t.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1998 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) > 45 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1977 AND s.gp > 31 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6175 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 2020 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 475 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 1945 AND t.w > 51 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 445 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 2004 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 243 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1994 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7978 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 13 AND s.pts >= 95 AND t.year BETWEEN 1993 AND 2007 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 187 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 20 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 1999 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 31 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 41 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3807 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1968 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 92 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage FROM teams t JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1931 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 58 ORDER BY year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1925 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 2015 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 1912 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 2012 AND s.gp >= 28 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7641 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND s.g >= 51 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1958 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 76 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 959 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1916 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1912 AND t.year <= 1943 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 440 ORDER BY t.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1943 AND t.w > 64 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4082 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1994 AND s.gp >= 35 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND t.year <= 1935 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1481 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1909 AND 2012 AND t.g > 23 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND m.birthyear::integer > 1980 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 178 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.w > 30 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 49 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.w > 13 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;
