SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Season' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Season' ELSE 'Even Season' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1993 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 3 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1911 AND t.year <= 1915 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 39 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year) AS lg_avg_win_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.w DESC) AS lg_rank FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 1962 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teamspost tp WHERE tp.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND tp.w > 14) GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(t.g) > 78 ORDER BY t.year DESC, lg_rank;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 12 AND t2.w > 16 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 1991 AND s.gp > 46 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 312 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' AND lgid = 'NHL') AND t.g >= 30.12 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 212.16 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1961 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4186 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts AS player_points, s.pim, m.lastname, m.firstname FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND t.year <= 2003 AND (t.w > 2 OR t.l < 8) AND NOT (t.pts < 161) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, m.lastname, m.firstname ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 1965 AND s.pts > 13 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 1984 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4310 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 2019 AND s.pts > 37 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 13 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2006 AND t.year <= 1929 AND s.gp > 36 AND s.pts > 71 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 398 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.g) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.w) * 100.0) / SUM(t.g), 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_percentage, CASE WHEN SUM(t.gf) > 0 AND SUM(t.ga) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(t.gf) * 1.0) / SUM(t.ga), 3) ELSE 0 END AS goals_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_scorer_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1919 AND 1940 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 56 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 57 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 1932 AND t.g > 43 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 339 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2005 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 29 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 1978 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 8 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 31 AND t2.l < 10 AND t1.g >= 69 AND t2.g >= 80 AND t1.year >= 1983 AND t2.year <= 1981 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 59 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 32 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS w1, t2.w AS w2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid != t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 48 AND t2.w > 39 AND t1.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 1937 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY total_wins DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2004 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2000) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.p_id = s.playerid WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.g > 60 GROUP BY m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY award_count DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m WHERE m.birthcity LIKE '1' AND m.birthcountry = '1' ORDER BY m.firstname, m.lastname;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 39.77 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 6.9 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1991 AND s.pts > 76 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1997 AND s.pts > 61 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1997 AND s.pts > 65 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 33 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2000 AND s.pts > 68 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS team_goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.coachid::character varying AND t.year = ac.year JOIN coaches c ON ac.coachid = c.c_id AND t.year = c.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE t.year >= 1902 AND t.year <= 1918 AND s.gp > 74 AND ap.award IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.g) > 863 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 12 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, distinct_awards_count DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, AVG(ts.g) AS avg_games_per_half, SUM(ts.w) AS total_wins, SUM(ts.l) AS total_losses, SUM(ts.t) AS total_ties, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(ts.w) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.year = tsc.year AND t.tmid = tsc.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 2007 AND ts.half = 1 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(ts.w) > 64 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'N%' AND s.g > 10.34 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1923 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 102 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE w > 60 AND l < 67) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.16 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 1940 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 69 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2016 AND s.g >= 11 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1996 AND s.g >= 6 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND s.g >= 71 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.lastname, ', ' ORDER BY m.lastname) AS player_names, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 2006 AND s.g >= 23 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2500 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_teams, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1922 AND 1981 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.g) > 30 ORDER BY t.year DESC, high_win_teams DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 1955 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 100 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1973 AND s.gp >= 49 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 8 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 2023 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 68 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_against ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1919 AND t.year <= 1944 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 45 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 2015 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.playerid, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT g.sho) FILTER (WHERE g.sho::integer > 0) AS shutouts_with_goalie, MAX(sp.w) AS max_playoff_wins_by_team, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.half = 1 THEN ts.gf ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_goals_for, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.half = 2 THEN ts.gf ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goalies g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamshalf ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1983 AND t.g >= 20 AND s.gp >= 71 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.playerid, m.lastname), (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 29 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_player_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1909 AND t.year <= 1901 AND t.w > 33 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 86 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 45.37 AND t2.w > 64.81 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 57 AND t2.w > 26 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 52.87 AND s.a > 54.46 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 20.95 OR s.pts > 100.37 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 253.66 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1993.94 AND 2014.69 AND s.gp > 66.82 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 31.39 AND t.l < 14.34 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 270.32 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 81 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1990 AND s.pts > 48 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'N%' AND s.g > 92.37 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 51 AND s.pts >= 139 AND t.year BETWEEN 1984 AND 2008 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 94 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 18 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1948 AND t.year <= 1906 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 780 ORDER BY t.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1944 AND 2015 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g > 80 AND m.birthcountry = 'CAN' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 31 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goals_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2006 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 56 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 31 AND t2.w > 58 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t2.tmid AS opp_tmid, SUM(t1.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t2.l) AS total_opp_losses, AVG(t1.gf - t1.ga) AS avg_goal_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t1.year = tv.year AND t1.tmid = tv.tmid AND t1.lgid = tv.lgid JOIN teams t2 ON tv.oppid = t2.tmid AND tv.year = t2.year AND tv.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.year >= 1990 AND t1.year <= 1966 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t2.tmid HAVING SUM(t1.w) > 19 AND SUM(t2.l) > 30 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1981 AND s.g > 38 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND s.pts > 64 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1919 AND t.year <= 2005 AND s.gp > 33 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 136 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'N' AND s.pos LIKE 'C' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 440.61 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers ap JOIN teams t ON ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid WHERE ap.year >= 2011 AND t.w >= 75 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1905 AND t.year <= 2015 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 1942 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4455 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Season' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Season' ELSE 'Even Season' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 1976 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 75 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1995 AND 1996 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 11 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 50 AND t2.l < 21 AND t1.year >= 1990 AND t2.year <= 2000 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 63 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 76 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 16 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 17 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;
SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 1954 AND ac.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year >= 1939 AND ap.year <= 1946 GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 49 INTERSECT SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE h.category = 'Player' GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 45 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 86.64 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 61.27 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 48.15 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2011.81 AND s.g > 16.19 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 175.54 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2011.11 AND s.pts > 59.82 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.p_id = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.gp > 76 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 397 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(h.year) AS latest_hof_year FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1930 AND s.gp > 8 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.tmid, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 356 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, MAX(g.sho) AS max_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.lgid = s.lgid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid AND t.lgid = g.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1937 AND t.year <= 1905 AND t.rank1 <= 27 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) >= 21 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_lg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid) AS awards_in_year_lg FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1928 AND t.year <= 1904 AND t.w > 46 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid, t.pts HAVING SUM(t.g) > 61 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_pts_running FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.year FROM scoring s WHERE s.g > 17) AND t.w > 11 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 1973 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4429 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 2017 AND s.pts > 139 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 2004 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND s.g >= 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1972 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4260 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2008 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 20 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Even' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 81 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM hof WHERE year >= 1914 AND year <= 2007) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 91 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 41 AND t2.w > 41 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 41 AND t2.w > 43 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 38 AND t2.w > 73 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1990.5 AND s.g > 84.11 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 53 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 18 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid ORDER BY s.g DESC) AS rank_by_goals_by_league, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.lgid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts_by_league, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1986 AND s.pts > 63 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 45 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, s.lgid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 461 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.year <= 2012 AND s.gp > 68 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 53 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 2003 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3153 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1965 AND s.g >= 50 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 26 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t LEFT JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year = 1930 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 430 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.w > 60 AND t.l < 23 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 1980 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9414 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1955 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND s.gp > 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 18 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.year <= 1944 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 2001 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.year <= 1984 AND s.gp > 95 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 150 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 1985 AND s.gp > 70 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 305 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1942 AND 1934 AND t.g > 90 AND s.gp > 19 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 286 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2009 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Season' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Season' ELSE 'Even Season' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1948 AND t.year <= 1982 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 64 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 55 AND t2.l < 36 AND t1.g >= 68 AND t2.g >= 76 AND t1.year >= 1983 AND t2.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 98 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 56 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 10 AND t2.w > 39 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 55.83 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 29.24 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1999 AND s.pts > 81 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year WHERE t.year >= 1959 AND t.year <= 1919 AND s.gp > 28 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 351 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_points_rank;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.name LIKE '%' AND t.year BETWEEN 1932.45 AND 1985.25 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 99.81 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.w >= 38 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 33 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.w > 59 AND t.l < 14 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga HAVING (t.gf - t.ga) > -42 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 2004 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7021 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 1988 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.year <= 2001 AND s.gp > 54 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 235 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1961 AND s.g >= 66 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 35 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1908 AND t.year <= 2009 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 206 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1953 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1933 AND t.year <= 1956 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1979 AND s.gp >= 13 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1937 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 3 AND AVG(t.w) >= 51 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_games DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1933 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 51 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 5 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2007 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) ) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 17 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 43.27 AND t2.w > 31.38 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 54 AND t2.w > 73 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1990 AND s.g >= 64 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2019 AND s.g >= 29 GROUP BY s.playerid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 189 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 39 AND l < 12 ) AND s.g > 22 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 57 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 20 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1985 AND s.pts > 78 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.pts > 11 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2002 AND s.pts > 83 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 221 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_rate, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE w > 59 AND year BETWEEN 1917 AND 2021) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.56 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 1937 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid ORDER BY ap.year DESC, ap.playerid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 717 ) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, AVG(t.g) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_games_per_season, SUM(t.w) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 2016 AND t.pts > 104 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.lgid, t.g HAVING SUM(t.w) > 72 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1906 AND t.year <= 2001 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7365 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1958 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 2018 AND s.gp > 28 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 258 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1916 AND t.year <= 1919 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) > 5 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1930 AND t.year <= 1942 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS win_rate_rolling_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.w DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1986 AND t.pts >= 46 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, league_rank;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 7 AND t2.w > 21 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 79 AND t2.w > 67 AND t1.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 1931 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1986 AND s.pts > 29 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1945 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 21 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 71 AND t2.w > 78 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2018 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 1989 AND s.g > 99 AND t.w > 37 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 2020 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 28) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 276 AND SUM(s.a) > 671 AND COUNT(*) >= 14 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 1994 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.g > 20 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2002 AND s.pts > 82 AND s.g >= 25 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2013.7 AND s.pts > 33.62 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE(t.year::text || '-01-01')) AS season_year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.g AS INTEGER), 0)) AS total_goals, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.a AS INTEGER), 0)) AS total_assists, AVG(COALESCE(CAST(gp.ga AS INTEGER), 0)) FILTER (WHERE gp.ga IS NOT NULL) AS avg_goals_against, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.pts AS INTEGER), 0)) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goaliessc gp ON s.tmid = gp.tmid AND s.year = gp.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 1936 AND COALESCE(CAST(s.g AS INTEGER), 0) > 82 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, season_year) HAVING SUM(COALESCE(CAST(s.pts AS INTEGER), 0)) > 57 ORDER BY t.lgid, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, MAX(h.year) AS latest_hof_year FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 2022 AND s.gp > 96 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.playerid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 876 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname, m.lastname, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_game, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.tmid = tsc.tmid AND t.year = tsc.year JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.g > 44 AND th.half = 1 AND tp.g > 5 GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, t.year HAVING AVG(s.g) > 0.27 AND SUM(s.pts) > 74 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_goals_per_game DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1996 AND 2002 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'NHL') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 4 AND t.w < 32) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 15 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1995 AND t.w > 27 AND t.l < 40 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year) AS avg_win_pct_by_league_year FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teamspost tp WHERE tp.tmid = t.tmid AND tp.year = t.year AND tp.w > 16 ) AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, t.g, t.lgid ORDER BY goal_diff DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts AS player_pts, m.lastname, m.firstname, a.award FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year = 1920 AND t.w > 65 AND (s.g > 91 OR s.a > 96) AND NOT (t.l > 57) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, m.lastname, m.firstname, a.award ORDER BY t.pts DESC, player_pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1968 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 2008 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 48 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 2021 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 22 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 11 AND t2.w > 20 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 31.3 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 12.61 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND s.pts > 50 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1996 AND s.pts > 114 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1905 AND t.year <= 1956 AND s.gp > 56 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 353 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_pts_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 13 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, s.pts, t.lgid ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1963 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 7011 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1976 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 82 INTERSECT SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage FROM teams t JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1986 AND t.year <= 1919 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 93 ORDER BY year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 2018 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.pos, ', ' ORDER BY s.pos) AS positions_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1913 AND t.year <= 1920 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 14 ORDER BY t.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1985 AND ap.award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1974 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 134 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1929 AND t.year <= 1936 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 1974 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 41 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 370 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_player, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN h.hofid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_hof_players, SUM(t.w) AS team_wins, SUM(t.l) AS team_losses, SUM(t.g) AS team_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS team_rank_by_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_rank_by_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1909 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 12 AND s.pts >= 173 GROUP BY CUBE (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3096 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_rate, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS rank_by_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1912 AND t.year <= 2005 AND t.g > 70 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 14 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.91 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_by_wins ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 2001 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2020 AND s.g > 70 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 38 AND l < 21 ) AND s.g > 46 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2014 AND s.pts > 40 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp > 8 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 51 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1967 AND t.w > 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 11 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.g) > 8739 ORDER BY win_pct DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1970 AND s.pts > 103 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1947 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 43 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1954 AND s.gp > 29 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1902 AND s.gp > 70 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 19 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1920 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1976 AND s.gp >= 31 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4069 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_rank_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.playoff = 'Y' THEN t.year END) AS playoff_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1981 AND 1986 AND t.g >= 22 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 54 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1924 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 23 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 53 AND t2.w > 39 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t2.tmid AS opp_tmid, SUM(t1.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t2.l) AS total_opp_losses, AVG(t1.gf - t1.ga) AS avg_goal_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t1.year = tv.year AND t1.tmid = tv.tmid AND t1.lgid = tv.lgid JOIN teams t2 ON tv.oppid = t2.tmid AND tv.year = t2.year AND tv.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.year >= 1964 AND t1.year <= 1962 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t2.tmid HAVING SUM(t1.w) > 70 AND SUM(t2.l) > 50 ORDER BY t1.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 37.83 AND s.a > 63.43 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 35.21 AND s.pts >= 99.24 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 116.02 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 14.3 AND s.a < 7.09 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1985.09 AND 2006.83 AND s.g >= 30.24 AND s.pts > 36.33 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 226.94 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 109.61 AND AVG(s.pts) > 38.12 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 2007 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2001 AND s.g > 35 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2009 AND s.pts > 64 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 12 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
