SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid ORDER BY s.g DESC) AS rank_by_goals_by_league, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.lgid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts_by_league, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1992 AND s.pts > 86 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 42 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, s.lgid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 125 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_points_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 2009 AND s.gp > 41 GROUP BY t.name, t.tmid, m.firstname, m.lastname, m.p_id HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name, player_name;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.year <= 1900 AND t.w > 39 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 42 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2012 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 20) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 13 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 3 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_points_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS total_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_team_goals FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 2001 AND t.w > 67 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.lgid, s.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_team_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2000 AND t.w > 1 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 31 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1906 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 43 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND m.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND t.year >= 1987.44 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4784.35 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year) AS avg_win_pct_by_league_year FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 2015 AND t.gf > 251 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t2 WHERE t2.lgid = t.lgid AND t2.year = t.year AND t2.w > 57 ORDER BY t2.w DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, t.lgid, t.g HAVING SUM(t.w) > 39 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid) AS avg_league_pts_per_game FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1948 AND t.year <= 1998 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.lgid, s.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING t.pts > 103 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 2009 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 1915 AND a.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4957 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 2001 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1989 AND s.g >= 95 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2586 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1952 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 661 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 2017 AND s.gp > 30 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3984 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 1959 AND ap.award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1903 AND t.year <= 1987 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 4) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 197 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 15 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1997 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1936 AND t.year <= 2015 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 99 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 43 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, SUM(g.sho) AS total_shutouts, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 2019 AND t.w > 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 11 AND SUM(s.pts) > 765 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_pts_3yr, SUM(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.pts >= 143 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 48.23 AND t2.w > 65.2 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2009 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1987 AND 2010 AND t.g > 49 AND s.gp > 52 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 31 AND SUM(s.g) > 2036 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_pts_3yr, SUM(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.pts >= 78 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 1.6 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1982 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2013 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2000 AND t.w > 37 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year) ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp AS goalie_gp, g.w AS goalie_w, g.l AS goalie_l, g.sho AS goalie_sho, g.ga AS goalie_ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid) AS avg_team_pts_per_player, SUM(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid ORDER BY s.pts DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_team_pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS team_pts_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.tmid) AS team_player_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS award_count_this_year, (SELECT SUM(sp.w) FROM teamspost sp WHERE sp.year = s.year AND sp.tmid = s.tmid) AS playoff_wins, (SELECT AVG(ts.gf) FROM teamshalf ts WHERE ts.year = s.year AND ts.tmid = s.tmid) AS avg_goals_per_half FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid LEFT JOIN goalies g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON s.year = th.year AND s.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON s.year = tp.year AND s.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN teamvsteam tv ON s.year = tv.year AND s.tmid = tv.tmid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON s.year = ts.year AND s.tmid = ts.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON s.year = sp.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = s.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = s.tmid) WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.year <= 1994 AND s.gp > 35 AND t.rank1 <= 7 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(s.year || '-01-01')) BETWEEN 5 AND 9 OR EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM DATE(s.year || '-01-01')) = 2) GROUP BY t.name, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp, g.w, g.l, g.sho, g.ga, s.playerid, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 86 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, m.firstname AS player_firstname, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp AS goalie_gp, g.w AS goalie_w, g.l AS goalie_l, g.sho AS goalie_sho, c.g AS coach_g, c.w AS coach_w, c.l AS coach_l, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, t.lgid) AS avg_pts_per_lg_year, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS career_goals_running, COUNT(a.award) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_awards, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank_year, (s.g * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.gp, 0)) AS goals_per_game_pct FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN teams t ON s.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND s.tmid = t.tmid LEFT JOIN goaliessc g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON m.coachid = c.c_id AND s.year = c.year LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.pk_id = th.year_tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.pk_id = tp.year_tmid AND t.year = tp.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.year <= 2022 AND s.gp > 26 AND t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 1961 AND th.half = 2 AND tp.g > 14 AND sp.round = 'P' GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.year, s.gp, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, g.gp, g.w, g.l, g.sho, c.g, c.w, c.l, t.lgid, s.playerid, a.award HAVING SUM(s.g) > 30 AND AVG(s.pts) > 174 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE rank1 <= 13) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 358 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1990 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 179 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 2017 AND s.g > 80 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC) AS rank_in_year FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 55 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(th.gf) > 200 ORDER BY t.year DESC, rank_in_year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1997 AND t.year <= 2004 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Lady Byng Trophy' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6625 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 2006 AND t.w > 53 AND s.gp > 19 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts HAVING SUM(s.g) > 89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 17 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1930 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1990 AND t.year <= 1995 AND s.gp > 3 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 172 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1938 AND t.year <= 1995 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) > 34 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1946 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 19 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1999 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 298 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1984 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3273 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.t) AS total_ties, SUM(t.pts) AS total_points, SUM(t.gf) AS goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS goals_against, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1955 AND t.year <= 2022 AND t.g > 19 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 37 AND t2.w > 59 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 3.76 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS num_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid) AS avg_goals_per_player_in_season_league, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM master m LEFT JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying AND s.year = ap.year AND s.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year AND s.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year AND t.lgid = th.lgid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.tmid = tv.tmid AND t.year = tv.year AND t.lgid = tv.lgid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year AND t.lgid = ts.lgid LEFT JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.tmid = gs.tmid AND s.year = gs.year AND s.lgid = gs.lgid LEFT JOIN scoringsc sc ON s.tmid = sc.tmid AND s.year = sc.year AND s.lgid = sc.lgid WHERE s.year >= 1941 AND s.year <= 2001 AND s.gp >= 97 GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, s.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 426 ORDER BY total_points DESC, s.year ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 1987 AND s.g >= 47 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2010 AND s.pts > 93 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1983 AND s.pts > 145 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2017 AND s.pts > 14 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1990 AND s.pts > 72 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND s.pts > 63 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.g > 41 AND s.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 1941 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING AVG(s.g) > 8.89 ORDER BY s.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1904 AND t.year <= 2005 AND m.lastname LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year AS season, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy') AS hart_trophy_winners_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid LEFT JOIN goaliessc gs ON t.year = gs.year AND t.tmid = gs.tmid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1974 AND 2010 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 79 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > (SELECT AVG(pts) * 1.5 FROM scoring WHERE year = t.year AND lgid = t.lgid) AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 25 ORDER BY total_points DESC, unique_players ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 1987 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1920 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND t.year <= 1907 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 2006 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 2019 AND s.gp > 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 62 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(g.gp::integer) AS avg_goalie_games FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2009 AND t.year <= 1995 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9522 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS total_teams, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_teams, SUM(CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_ranked_teams, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2001 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.g) > 61 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_teams DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.w::numeric) AS median_wins, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.gf::numeric) AS percentile_75_goals_for, AVG(t.ga::numeric) AS avg_goals_against, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1925 AND t.year <= 1927 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric) > 78.55 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1953 AND t.year <= 1951 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 57 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1420 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1923 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g > 49 AND s.pts > 153 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 50 AND SUM(s.pts) > 3411 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid) AS awards_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1940 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 42 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, MAX(g.sho) AS max_shutouts, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hall_of_fame_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON s.playerid::character varying = h.hofid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2019 AND t.year <= 1912 AND s.gp >= 37 AND g.gp >= 17 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 675 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 13 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2016 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2013.86 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 1982 ) AND g > 19 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1986 AND s.pts > 98 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1950 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 86 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 179 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 2019 AND m.lastname LIKE 'A' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4968 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.year FROM scoring s WHERE s.g > 29) AND t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1947 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1953 AND ap.year >= 1958 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.year <= 1956 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 70 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 43 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 1983 AND s.g >= 40 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 33 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp > 20 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 51 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Record' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Record' ELSE 'Even Record' END AS record_category FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1945 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) >= 44 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_previous_year, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 19 AND t2.w > 46 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 77 AND SUM(s.a) > 78 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1953 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (s.gp < 43) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 123 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1913 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 9) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2396 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 2016 AND 1983 GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 26 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w AS w_prev, t2.l AS l_prev, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t1.l - t2.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 21 AND t2.w > 49 AND t1.year >= 1924 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l ORDER BY win_diff DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 2003 AND m.lastname LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 2020 AND (t.w > 72 OR t.l < 37) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 373 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1911 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1466 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1914 AND t.year <= 1965 AND t.w > 47 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 663 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, ROUND(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0) * 100, 2) AS win_pct FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 49 AND t.year BETWEEN 1982 AND 1983 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY win_pct DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1972 AND t.year <= 1963 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 495 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, m.playerid, m.lastname, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_award_occurrences, MAX(g.sho) AS max_shutouts, COUNT(DISTINCT g.year) AS seasons_played_as_goalie FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN goalies g ON s.playerid = g.playerid AND s.year = g.year LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1914 AND t.year <= 1959 AND s.gp >= 58 AND (s.pts >= 185 OR s.pts IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, m.playerid, m.lastname, s.pos), (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 463 OR GROUPING(t.tmid) = 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1904 AND t.year <= 2015 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hof h WHERE h.hofid = m.hofid AND h.category = 'Player') GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(t.w) > 43 ORDER BY award_players_count DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t1.l) AS net_wins_first, (t2.w - t2.l) AS net_wins_second FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year < t2.year WHERE t1.w > 40 AND t2.l < 24 AND t1.year >= 1990 AND t2.year <= 2001 AND t1.lgid = 'NHL' AND (t1.w + t1.l) > 66 AND (t2.w + t2.l) > 60 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w - t1.l) > 17 AND MAX(t2.w - t2.l) > 10 ORDER BY (t1.w - t1.l) DESC, (t2.w - t2.l) ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 39.0 AND t2.w > 34.2 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, ROUND((t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) * 100, 2) AS win_percentage, s.g AS player_games, s.pts AS player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') AND t.w > 22 AND s.pts > 132 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, s.g, s.pts ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1971 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 452 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1931 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 10 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1986.64 AND s.g > 77.1 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1991 AND s.pts > 16 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2015 AND s.pts > 84 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1986 AND s.pts > 81 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.pts > 90 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2007 AND s.g >= 37 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((s.year), (s.tmid), (s.year, s.tmid)) ORDER BY s.year, s.tmid;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t LEFT JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year = 1950 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1958 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1984 AND t.g > 99 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 332 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1915 AND t.g > 39 AND s.gp > 23 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1614 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid) AS awards_count FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 1962 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > (SELECT AVG(w) FROM teams WHERE year = t.year AND lgid = t.lgid) ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1966 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1944 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 16 AND t2.w > 9 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 2000.17 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 1996.89 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 1973 AND s.g > 81 AND t.w > 69 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1999 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 46) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 216 AND SUM(s.a) > 1200 AND COUNT(*) >= 13 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 1975 AND s.g > 76 AND t.w > 41 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1996 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 22) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 388 AND SUM(s.a) > 861 AND COUNT(*) >= 19 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year >= 1989 AND ap.award = 'None') AS award_count FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1977 AND s.g > 85 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2006 AND s.pts > 47 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1955 AND t.w > 57 AND ap.award = 'Art Ross Trophy' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1990 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 65 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 2009 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4320 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1910 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1942 AND t.year <= 2007 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 1915 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1922 AND s.g >= 20 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 1930 AND s.gp > 61 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3429 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1996 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 33 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1975 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2014 AND t.year <= 2017 AND s.gp > 30 AND s.pts > 127 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 104 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) AND sp.round = 'P' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 1968 AND 1941 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 57 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 1968 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 1985 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 37 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1967 AND t.year <= 1954 AND t.w > 80 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 80 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 68.41 AND t2.w > 49.5 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 2006.89 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 3.03 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year IN ( SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(*) > 5.59 ) GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, ap.year, ap.award ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, ROUND((t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) * 100, 2) AS win_percentage, s.g AS player_games, s.pts AS player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Memorial Trophy') AND t.w > 20 AND s.pts > 121 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, s.g, s.pts ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1911 AND t.year <= 1971 AND s.g >= 98 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) > 40 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.lastname, ', ' ORDER BY m.lastname) AS player_names, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 166 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 1986) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.p_id = s.playerid WHERE s.year >= 1981 AND s.g > 92 GROUP BY m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY award_count DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1985 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2011 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1945 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4459 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1983 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 373 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year) AS avg_pts_per_year_by_league FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 15 AND th.half = 2 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.lgid, t.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.pts, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.coachid WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.year <= 1988 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hof h WHERE h.hofid = m.hofid AND h.year >= 1963 LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.pts HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 14 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1991 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachid) AS award_coaches, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.year = ac.year AND t.lgid = ac.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(t.w) > 70 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1960 AND t.year <= 1920 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 74 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.g) AS total_games_coached FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1931 AND t.year <= 1929 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(c.g) > 49 OR SUM(c.g) IS NULL ORDER BY t.year DESC, coach_count DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 39.99 AND s.a > 37.9 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 49.55 OR s.pts > 105.76 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 165.32 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1991.86 AND 2011.25 AND s.gp > 79.17 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 38.29 AND t.l < 28.53 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 698.11 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 59.98 AND s.a > 77.15 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g >= 32.4 AND s.pts >= 78.55 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 132.94 THEN 'Physical Player' WHEN s.g < 5.25 AND s.a < 7.94 THEN 'Low Impact' ELSE 'Average' END AS player_category, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year) AS total_players_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart', 'Art Ross', 'Norris')) AS num_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1980.18 AND 2006.66 AND s.g >= 15.8 AND s.pts > 30.14 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.pim <= 173.69 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim HAVING SUM(s.g) > 104.42 AND AVG(s.pts) > 44.19 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.a) AS median_assists, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.lgid = t.lgid WHERE s.year >= 1916 AND s.year <= 2020 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1618 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.tmid = tsc.tmid AND t.year = tsc.year JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.tmid = tv.tmid AND t.year = tv.year JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year WHERE t.year >= 1926 AND t.year <= 1943 AND s.gp > 20 AND s.pts > 140 AND t.rank1 <= 28 AND th.half = 2 AND tp.g > 29 AND tv.w > 9 AND ts.janw > 11 AND gs.w > 50 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_points_rank;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1902 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 555 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM teams WHERE w > 30 AND l < 76) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.93 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1915 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1905 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 2007 AND t.w > 14 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 575 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1960 AND t.rank1 > 30 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Record' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Record' ELSE 'Even Record' END AS record_category FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 2022 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) >= 96 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year) AS lg_avg_win_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.w DESC) AS lg_rank FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 1930 AND t.year <= 1937 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teamspost tp WHERE tp.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND tp.w > 15) GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(t.g) > 62 ORDER BY t.year DESC, lg_rank;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS combined_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 9 AND t2.w > 21 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1928 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.tmid, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 28 ORDER BY combined_wins DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1998 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2019 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1995 AND s.pts > 77 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(s.g) AS avg_player_goals, SUM(s.pts) AS total_team_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1976 AND t.year <= 1997 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hof h WHERE h.hofid = m.hofid AND h.year <= 1999 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3672 ORDER BY total_team_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1927 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 81 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2017 ) AND g > 70 ORDER BY pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2019 AND s.g >= 72 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.pts > 13 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.pts > 50 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 70 AND s.pts > 80 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 6 AND g.gp::integer > 39 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2001 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 67 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1950 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 302 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.pts) AS total_points, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(g.sho::integer) AS total_shutouts, AVG(g.ga::numeric) AS avg_goals_against, SUM(sp.w) AS playoff_wins, SUM(sp.l) AS playoff_losses, SUM(tsh.w) AS first_half_wins, SUM(tsh.l) AS first_half_losses, SUM(tsh2.w) AS second_half_wins, SUM(tsh2.l) AS second_half_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN t.year >= 2010 THEN t.w ELSE 0 END) AS recent_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN t.year >= 2016 THEN t.l ELSE 0 END) AS recent_losses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, LAG(SUM(t.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, SUM(t.pts) - LAG(SUM(t.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS points_change FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid JOIN teamspost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND t.tmid = sp.tmid JOIN teamshalf tsh ON t.year = tsh.year AND t.tmid = tsh.tmid AND tsh.half = 1 JOIN teamshalf tsh2 ON t.year = tsh2.year AND t.tmid = tsh2.tmid AND tsh2.half = 2 JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid JOIN seriespost sr ON t.year = sr.year AND (t.tmid = sr.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sr.tmidloser) JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1945 AND 2009 AND t.rank1 <= 10 AND s.gp >= 31 AND g.gp >= 46 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 90 AND SUM(t.l) < 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 27 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 1949 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 9283 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1989 AND t.year <= 1935 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1932 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3342 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1917 AND t.g > 83 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 75 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Season' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Season' ELSE 'Even Season' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 1916 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 31 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_player_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1991 AND t.year <= 1962 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 96 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 31 AND t2.w > 20 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.pts > 71 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT sp.year FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.w > 0) AND t.w > 76 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, t.g, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(t.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pts_3yr_rolling, AVG(t.gf) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_gf_3yr_rolling FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.pts > 0 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year, t.g, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;
