SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) AS avg_wins_per_team FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1965 AND t.year <= 1919 AND th.half = 1 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 28 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 52 AND t2.w > 34 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1993 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 95 AND SUM(s.a) > 150 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1939 AND t.year <= 1924 AND s.g > 51 GROUP BY t.name, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 683 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, s.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, AVG(ts.g) AS avg_games_per_half, SUM(ts.w) AS total_wins, SUM(ts.l) AS total_losses, SUM(ts.t) AS total_ties, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(ts.w) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.year = tsc.year AND t.tmid = tsc.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1969 AND t.year <= 1979 AND ts.half = 1 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(ts.w) > 53 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1940 AND t.year <= 2007 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 315 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1979 AND t.year <= 2020 AND s.g >= 55 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1921 AND t.year <= 1993 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3021 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1978 AND t.year <= 1955 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 1978 AND s.gp >= 83 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1375 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 33 AND t.w > 34 AND s.year >= 1989 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year HAVING SUM(s.g) + SUM(s.a) > 25 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year > 2012 AND s.g >= 14 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 34 AND lgid = 'None' ) AND s.g > 22 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2016 AND s.pts > 16 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1999 AND 1996 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'WHA') AND NOT (t.w < 34 AND t.l > 61) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.g) > 73 AND AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) < 0.6 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS distinct_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1964 AND 1976 AND t.g > 64 AND s.gp > 46 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 23 AND SUM(s.g) > 4498 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1932 AND t.year <= 1990 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1911 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3675 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1941 AND t.year <= 1925 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 95 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1963 AND t.w > 71 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 539 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 40.99 AND t2.w > 54.05 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;
SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2019 AND ap.award = 'None' );

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(s.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid, t.year) AS avg_player_pts, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 2009 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, s.pts ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1979 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) >= 8 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_first, t1.l AS losses_first, t2.w AS wins_second, t2.l AS losses_second, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_diff, (t2.l - t1.l) AS loss_diff FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year - 1 WHERE t1.w > 56 AND t2.l < 16 AND t1.g >= 64 AND t2.g >= 68 AND t1.year >= 1995 AND t2.year <= 1990 GROUP BY t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w, t1.l, t2.w, t2.l HAVING AVG(t1.w + t2.w) > 69 AND SUM(t1.l + t2.l) < 25 ORDER BY win_diff DESC, loss_diff ASC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS combined_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 36 AND t2.w > 24 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1959 AND 1923 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.tmid, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 118 ORDER BY combined_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(*) AS seasons FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 1989 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 842 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 45 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 2008 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6391 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 1962 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 9 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.year <= 1902 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 255 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1961 AND t.year <= 2014 AND s.g > 54 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4864 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.lastname, ', ' ORDER BY m.lastname) AS player_names, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1926 AND s.g >= 11 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 247 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, LAG(SUM(t.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_games, SUM(SUM(t.g)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_games FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND t.year <= 1987 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.g) > 24 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE ap.award LIKE 'None' AND m.birthstate LIKE 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 1.47 ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(*) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE s.year >= 1995 AND s.g > 34 AND t.w > 63 AND ap.award IN (SELECT award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1993 GROUP BY award HAVING COUNT(*) > 34) GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 749 AND SUM(s.a) > 564 AND COUNT(*) >= 6 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2005 AND s.pts > 21 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 2007 AND t.g > 66 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 453 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goal_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1980 AND t.year <= 2002 GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 201 ORDER BY t.year, goal_rank;

SELECT t.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalties FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 49 AND t.year >= 1994 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 49 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.gp) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.g > 48 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 365 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.gp) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE s.year >= 2011 AND s.g > 45 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 145 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year AS team_year, t.lgid AS league_id, t.tmid AS team_id, s.playerid AS scoring_player_id, g.playerid AS goalie_player_id, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.year_tmid) AS seasons_played, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_season, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_season, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(CASE WHEN g.gp IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.gp AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(CASE WHEN g.w IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.w AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.l IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.l AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(CASE WHEN g.sho IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.sho AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_shutouts, AVG(CASE WHEN g.ga IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.ga AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_goals_against, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_player_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.award) AS distinct_coach_awards, MAX(t.rank1) AS best_team_rank, SUM(t.w) AS total_team_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_team_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_team_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_win_rank, LAG(SUM(t.w), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS previous_year_wins, SUM(t.w) - LAG(SUM(t.w), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS win_change_from_previous FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON s.year = g.year AND s.tmid = g.tmid AND s.playerid = g.playerid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON m.coachid = ac.coachid AND t.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid LEFT JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1958 AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(t.year || '-01-01')) BETWEEN 7 AND 3 OR t.year % 4 = 0) AND s.g >= 79 AND s.a >= 97 AND (CASE WHEN g.ga IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.ga AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) <= 349 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.playerid, g.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1145 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.year_tmid) >= 27 AND SUM(CASE WHEN g.w IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g.w AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) >= 225 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_win_rank ASC LIMIT 670;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 2015 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 2019 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1950 AND t.year <= 1930 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1189 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2010 AND t.year <= 1931 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 22 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1714 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 1988 AND t.g > 12 AND s.gp > 65 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 4783 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1925 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 3 THEN t.tmid END) AS top_ranked_teams_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.pts > 84 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_point_teams_count, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2006 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 31 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_player, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_awards, SUM(CASE WHEN h.hofid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_hof_players, SUM(t.w) AS team_wins, SUM(t.l) AS team_losses, SUM(t.g) AS team_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS team_rank_by_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_rank_by_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1943 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp >= 53 AND s.pts >= 1 GROUP BY CUBE (t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, s.pos) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 5254 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1949 AND t.year <= 2009 AND s.gp > 89 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 5888 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND (t.w > 40 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teamshalf th WHERE th.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND th.half = 1 AND th.w > 29)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.52 ORDER BY win_pct DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2004 AND t.year <= 1993 AND s.gp > 71 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 194 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1990 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 473 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1977 AND 1952 AND t.g > 14 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 498 ORDER BY total_games DESC, win_percentage DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1989.94 AND s.g > 34.59 AND s.lgid != 'NHL' ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS percentile_75_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid WHERE s.g > 42 AND t.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 2009 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 29 ORDER BY s.year DESC, player_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1911 AND t.year <= 2013 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 3047 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2005 AND t.year <= 1986 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 2000 AND s.gp > 55 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 481 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_points_rank, LAG(SUM(s.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 2012 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM MAKE_DATE(t.year, 1, 1)) = 3 AND s.gp > 70 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 333 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, SUM(t.t) AS total_ties, SUM(t.pts) AS total_points, SUM(t.gf) AS goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS goals_against, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1923 AND t.year <= 1920 AND t.g > 79 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1943 AND t.year <= 1998 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 75 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 75 AND t2.w > 34 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.playerid IS NOT NULL) AS star_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.pts >= 79 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, t.g, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 486 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 1969 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 2007 AND s.gp > 55 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 198 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses FROM teams t WHERE t.year >= 2015 AND t.lgid = '' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), (t.lgid), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2011 AND t.year <= 1998 AND t.g > 18 AND s.gp > 5 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 157 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1959 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 53 AND t2.w > 31 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year >= 1998 AND award = 'None' INTERSECT SELECT playerid, year, award FROM awardsplayers WHERE year <= 2007 AND lgid = 'None';

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 37.73 AND s.a > 45.13 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 41.49 OR s.pts > 63.13 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 149.35 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1980.13 AND 2009.86 AND s.gp > 45.03 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 54.59 AND t.l < 27.27 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 562.74 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g AS goals, s.a AS assists, s.pts AS points, CASE WHEN s.pts >= 87.33 THEN 'Elite' WHEN s.pts >= 64.43 THEN 'Star' WHEN s.pts >= 32.38 THEN 'Contributor' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS performance_tier, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS seasons_played FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1989.12 AND s.g > 12.2 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 472.29 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.g > 44 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2014 AND t.lgid = 'None' GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 42 AND SUM(s.a) > 117 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, total_assists DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND t.year <= 1945 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1973 AND t.year <= 1982 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2012 AND t.year <= 1971 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1918 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 41 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND t.year <= 1949 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1985 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 352 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 86 AND s.pts >= 47 AND t.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 2006 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 491 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2003 AND t.w > 22 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 24 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1998 AND a.year <= 1951 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1924 AND t.year <= 2005 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1907 AND t.year <= 1986 AND t.w > 28 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 46 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(c.g) AS total_games_coached FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmid = c.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1970 AND t.year <= 2001 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(c.g) > 69 OR SUM(c.g) IS NULL ORDER BY t.year DESC, coach_count DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS w1, t2.w AS w2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 13 AND t2.w > 46 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1954 AND 1934 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 55 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS combined_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid WHERE t1.w > 81 AND t2.w > 40 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1992 AND 1992 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 41 ORDER BY combined_wins DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year FROM master m JOIN awardscoaches a ON m.coachid = a.coachid WHERE a.award LIKE '%' || 'None' || '%' AND a.year >= 1996.72 AND m.birthcountry = 'None' GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity, a.award, a.year HAVING COUNT(a.award) > 1.94 ORDER BY a.year DESC, m.lastname ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2001 AND s.pts > 50 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1954 AND (t.w > 81 OR t.l < 32) AND NOT (t.lgid = 'NHL') GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 51 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.pts) OVER(PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_pts_running FROM teams t WHERE t.year IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.year FROM scoring s WHERE s.g > 52) AND t.w > 1 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.pts ORDER BY t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1901 AND t.year <= 1927 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2005 ) AND g > 73 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2020 ) AND pts > 89 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM teams WHERE w > 36 AND l < 30 ) AND s.g > 43 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2002 AND t.year <= 1951 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid ORDER BY ap.year DESC, ap.playerid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 744 ) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(ts.hw + ts.hl + ts.ht) AS avg_home_games, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid) WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1981 AND t.pts > 164 GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.pts, t.gf, t.ga, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 9 ORDER BY t.pts DESC, t.year;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY t.w DESC, t.l ASC) AS team_rank_in_year FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1951 AND t.year <= 1971 AND t.w > 28 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.2 ORDER BY win_pct DESC, total_goals_scored DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1906 AND t.year <= 1976 AND t.w > 93 AND s.g > 52 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.g) > 2915 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, (t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_diff, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.year) AS avg_win_pct_by_league_year FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1993 AND t.year <= 2019 AND t.gf > 211 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t2 WHERE t2.lgid = t.lgid AND t2.year = t.year AND t2.w > 48 ORDER BY t2.w DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, t.lgid, t.g HAVING SUM(t.w) > 44 ORDER BY goal_diff DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1968 AND t.year <= 1910 AND s.pts > 196 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1995 AND s.gp > 94 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 147 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1934 AND t.year <= 1999 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(t.gf) AS total_goals_for, SUM(t.ga) AS total_goals_against, SUM(t.gf - t.ga) AS goal_differential, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1944 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.g) > 3 ORDER BY t.year DESC, league_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1909 AND t.year <= 2018 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 82 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2003 AND s.pts > 76 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.tmid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_in_year, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid) AS avg_team_pts, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_goals_3yr FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2007 AND s.pts > 62 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 12 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.a) > 30 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_in_year ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2013 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 2006 AND (t.lgid = 'NHL' OR t.lgid = 'NHL') AND NOT (t.rank1 > 27 AND t.w < 56) AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 44 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS num_awards, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid) AS avg_goals_per_player_in_season_lg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS overall_points_rank FROM master m LEFT JOIN scoring s ON m.playerid::character varying = s.playerid::character varying LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying AND s.year = ap.year AND s.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year AND s.lgid = t.lgid LEFT JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year AND t.lgid = th.lgid LEFT JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner AND t.year = sp.year LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year AND t.lgid = c.lgid LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON c.coachid::character varying = ac.coachid::character varying AND c.year = ac.year AND c.lgid = ac.lgid LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE s.gp > 29.98 AND s.year BETWEEN 1980.07 AND 1949.44 AND t.rank1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.tmid, s.lgid, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 473.36 ORDER BY total_points DESC, s.year ASC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2008 AND s.year <= 1944 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 2025 ORDER BY s.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year IN ( SELECT year FROM ( SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Lady Byng Memorial Trophy' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(*) > 19 ) AS sub ) GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING AVG(s.pts) > 51 ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, AVG(ts.hw + ts.hl + ts.ht) AS avg_home_games, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.w > sp.l THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playoff_series_won FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.lgid = tp.lgid LEFT JOIN seriespost sp ON t.year = sp.year AND (t.tmid = sp.tmidwinner OR t.tmid = sp.tmidloser) WHERE t.year >= 1985 AND t.year <= 1918 AND (t.w > 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy')) GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.t, t.gf, t.ga, t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.gf) > 31 AND AVG(t.ga) < 131 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.w DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1939 AND 1930 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 77 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 483 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1983 AND t.year <= 1932 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 301 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1989 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 24 AND t2.w > 45 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1996 AND s.pts > 68 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1916 AND t.year <= 1974 AND s.pts > 99 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins_split, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses_split, SUM(ts.ht + ts.rt) AS total_ties_split, LAG(SUM(t.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1967 AND t.g > 73 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.04 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2019 AND s.pts > 73 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_player_points, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hart_winners_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_win_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 1949 AND t.w > 7 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w HAVING SUM(t.w) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 45 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2016 AND s.pts > 30 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1954 AND t.year <= 1903 AND s.gp >= 97 GROUP BY CUBE(t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid) HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 1917 ORDER BY t.lgid, t.year, t.tmid, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, COUNT(s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE s.g > 98 AND s.pts >= 111 AND t.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2003 GROUP BY t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 234 AND COUNT(s.playerid) >= 13 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1945 AND t.year <= 1950 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4875 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2008 AND t.year <= 1936 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2013 AND t.year <= 1958 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 53 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_teams, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS unique_teams FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1949 AND 1992 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING AVG(t.g) > 42 ORDER BY t.year DESC, high_win_teams DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS win_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1919 AND t.year <= 1920 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 98 ORDER BY t.year, win_rank;

SELECT t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.lgid, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS previous_wins, (t1.w - t2.w) AS win_change FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 40.01 AND t2.w > 31.82 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.tmid, t1.lgid, t1.w, t2.w ORDER BY win_change DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid JOIN scoring s ON a.playerid = s.playerid AND a.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1920 AND t.year <= 1971 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1917 AND s.g >= 96 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1916 AND t.year <= 1951 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 473 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(CASE WHEN t.w > 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_win_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.rank1 <= 1 THEN t.year END) AS top_rank_years, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2003 AND t.year <= 1981 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING AVG(t.gf) > 323 ORDER BY t.year DESC, avg_goals_for DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1998 AND s.pts > 121 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.gp) AS avg_games_played FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE s.year >= 2005 AND s.g > 44 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 424 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1977 AND t.year <= 1929 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;
SELECT playerid, year, g, a, pts FROM scoring WHERE playerid IN ( SELECT playerid FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'None' AND year >= 2002 ) AND pts > 94 ORDER BY pts DESC;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 1981 AND s.pts > 73 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2004 AND s.pts > 53 ORDER BY s.year DESC, rank_by_points ASC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals_scored_by_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' AND m.lastname LIKE 'A%' AND t.year >= 1985.05 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.gf, t.ga HAVING SUM(s.g) > 346.53 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals_scored_by_players DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1910 AND t.year <= 2020 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 17 UNION ALL SELECT g.tmid, g.year, SUM(CAST(g.w AS INTEGER)) AS total_wins, AVG(CAST(g.gp AS INTEGER)) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS unique_goalies FROM goalies g JOIN awardsplayers ap ON g.playerid = ap.playerid AND g.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON g.playerid = m.p_id WHERE g.year >= 1963 AND g.year <= 1940 AND ap.award = 'Vezina Trophy' GROUP BY g.tmid, g.year HAVING SUM(CAST(g.w AS INTEGER)) > 13 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) AS team_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.w) AS median_wins, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.g) AS percentile_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1918 AND t.year <= 2020 AND t.w > 63 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tmid) > 17 ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid;

SELECT DISTINCT m.coachid, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM master m WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardscoaches ac WHERE ac.coachid = m.coachid AND ac.year >= 2006.34 AND ac.award = 'None' ) ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, CASE WHEN s.g > 65.8 AND s.a > 50.82 THEN 'Elite Scorer' WHEN s.g > 27.02 OR s.pts > 90.98 THEN 'High Producer' WHEN s.pim > 259.71 THEN 'Physical Player' ELSE 'Role Player' END AS player_role, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS rolling_avg_pts, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid) AS total_seasons, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year) AS career_goals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.year >= s.year - 1 AND ap.year <= s.year + 1) AS recent_major_awards FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1994.65 AND 2011.74 AND s.gp > 40.67 AND s.lgid IN (SELECT code FROM abbrev WHERE type = 'league' AND fullname LIKE '%NHL%') AND t.w > 30.56 AND t.l < 15.84 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.w, t.l HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 608.0 ORDER BY career_goals DESC, rolling_avg_pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.g) AS avg_games, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award) AS distinct_awards FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.name LIKE '%' AND t.year BETWEEN 2009.66 AND 1963.49 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(t.w) > 46.79 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.year = t.year AND ap.lgid = t.lgid AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' ) AND t.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 1929 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 55 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.firstname || ' ' || m.lastname AS player_name, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.pim) AS avg_penalty_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.playerid = gs.playerid AND s.year = gs.year JOIN teamshalf th ON t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.year = th.year JOIN teamspost tp ON t.tmid = tp.tmid AND t.year = tp.year JOIN teamssc tsc ON t.tmid = tsc.tmid AND t.year = tsc.year JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.tmid = tv.tmid AND t.year = tv.year JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.year = ts.year WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1941 AND s.gp > 48 AND s.pts > 61 AND t.rank1 <= 1 AND th.half = 2 AND tp.g > 15 AND tv.w > 0 AND ts.janw > 20 AND gs.w > 28 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 296 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, league_points_rank;
SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2012 AND s.pts > 50 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2022 AND t.year <= 1989 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 66 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, COALESCE(c.w, 0) AS coach_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1992 AND t.w > 33 AND t.l < 11 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.w, t.l, t.g, c.w ORDER BY t.w DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1981 AND t.year <= 2011 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) > 47 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals FROM teams t JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid JOIN scoring s ON ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 1905 AND t.year <= 1940 AND s.gp > 58 GROUP BY CUBE(t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) > 9 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1952 AND 1993 AND t.w > 21 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' AND m.birthcountry = 'CAN' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 48 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_rank ASC;

SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins_this_year, t2.w AS wins_previous_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 36.22 AND t2.w > 62.14 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_rate_3yr_rolling, SUM(t.gf) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS cumulative_gf, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) FILTER (WHERE ap.playerid IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_player_awards_count FROM teams t LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON t.year = ap.year AND t.lgid = ap.lgid LEFT JOIN master m ON ap.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.w > 16 GROUP BY t.pk_id, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, t.gf, t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_rate_3yr_rolling DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1957 AND t.year <= 1930 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) > 53 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.coachid) AS coach_count, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins FROM teams t LEFT JOIN coaches c ON t.tmid = c.tmid AND t.year = c.year WHERE t.year >= 1999 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 19 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') AND t.w > 15 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 709 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 1956 AND t.year <= 1909 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 208 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1926 AND 1943 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g > 87 AND m.birthcountry = 'CAN' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) > 14 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goals_rank;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1962 AND t.year <= 1911 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 339 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2021 AND s.g >= 9 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award, ', ' ORDER BY a.award) AS awards_list, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS award_count FROM teams t JOIN awardsmisc a ON t.year = a.year AND t.lgid = a.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1905 AND t.year <= 1980 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) > 67 ORDER BY t.year DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.coachid = ap.playerid WHERE m.birthcity LIKE 'None' AND ap.year >= 2012.23 GROUP BY m.firstname, m.lastname, m.birthcity ORDER BY m.lastname;

SELECT s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals_per_season, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS percentile_75_points_per_season FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 2013 AND s.year <= 2004 GROUP BY s.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.g) > 114 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name AS team_name FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.g > 61 AND s.pts > 71 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = s.playerid AND ap.year = s.year AND ap.award IN ('Hart Trophy', 'Art Ross Trophy', 'Maurice Richard Trophy') AND ap.lgid = s.lgid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goalies g WHERE g.playerid = s.playerid AND g.year = s.year AND g.sho::integer > 5 AND g.gp::integer > 48 ) AND s.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 2002 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY s.pts DESC, s.g DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT a.playerid) AS award_players FROM awardsplayers a JOIN teams t ON a.year = t.year AND a.lgid = t.lgid WHERE a.year >= 1933 AND t.w >= 91 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY award_players DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1966 AND t.year <= 1973 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, SUM(ts.hw + ts.rw) AS total_wins_split, SUM(ts.hl + ts.rl) AS total_losses_split, SUM(ts.ht + ts.rt) AS total_ties_split, LAG(SUM(t.g), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_games FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamsplits ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1958 AND t.year <= 1978 AND t.g > 56 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.16 ORDER BY t.year DESC, win_percentage DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_player_points, SUM(CASE WHEN a.award = 'Hart Trophy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hart_winners_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(t.w) DESC) AS league_win_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id LEFT JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE t.year >= 1927 AND t.year <= 1959 AND t.w > 13 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w HAVING SUM(t.w) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 17 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_wins DESC;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t1.gf) AS avg_gf_t1, AVG(t2.gf) AS avg_gf_t2 FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid != t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 28 AND t2.w > 27 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1939 AND 1918 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 24 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, t1.year ASC;

SELECT s.year, s.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.g) AS median_goals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.pts) AS median_points FROM scoring s JOIN teams t ON s.year = t.year AND s.tmid = t.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE s.year >= 1981 AND s.year <= 2001 GROUP BY s.year, s.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4732 ORDER BY s.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, m.lastname AS player_lastname, m.firstname AS player_firstname, s.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) AS distinct_awards_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.pts > 61 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_point_seasons, SUM(CASE WHEN s.gp < 39 THEN s.g ELSE 0 END) AS goals_in_low_gp_seasons, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.tmid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS team_player_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN teams t ON s.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND s.tmid = t.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year JOIN goaliessc gs ON s.year_tmid = gs.year_tmid JOIN teamshalf th ON s.year_tmid = th.year_tmid AND s.year = th.year JOIN teamvsteam tv ON s.year_tmid = tv.year_tmid AND s.year = tv.year WHERE s.year BETWEEN 1983 AND 1996 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.year, s.tmid, s.pts, s.gp HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 193 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ap.award) >= 4 ORDER BY team_player_rank, s.year DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.year, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1944 AND t.w >= 75 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.year UNION ALL SELECT sp.tmidwinner AS tmid, sp.year, COUNT(*) AS total_series_wins, MAX(sp.goalswinner) AS max_goals FROM seriespost sp JOIN teams t ON sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid AND sp.year = t.year WHERE sp.year >= 1900 AND sp.w >= 6 GROUP BY sp.tmidwinner, sp.year ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1934 AND t.year <= 1946 AND s.gp >= 79 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid), (t.year, t.lgid), (t.year), ()) ORDER BY t.year DESC, t.lgid, t.tmid;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.w) OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid, t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_wins FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1915 AND t.w > 42 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.w ORDER BY t.lgid, t.tmid, t.year;

SELECT t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w AS wins_t1, t2.w AS wins_t2, (t1.w + t2.w) AS combined_wins FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.lgid = t2.lgid AND t1.tmid < t2.tmid WHERE t1.w > 12 AND t2.w > 44 AND t1.year BETWEEN 1953 AND 2007 GROUP BY t1.year, t1.lgid, t1.tmid, t1.w, t2.tmid, t2.w HAVING (t1.w + t2.w) > 94 ORDER BY combined_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, SUM(t.l) AS total_losses, CASE WHEN SUM(t.w) > SUM(t.l) THEN 'Winning Season' WHEN SUM(t.w) < SUM(t.l) THEN 'Losing Season' ELSE 'Even Season' END AS season_outcome, AVG(t.gf) AS avg_goals_for, AVG(t.ga) AS avg_goals_against FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid WHERE t.year >= 1994 AND t.year <= 2006 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(t.w) + SUM(t.l) >= 4 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1947 AND t.year <= 2022 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 6886 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2017 AND t.year <= 1953 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1356 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.lgid, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(*) AS seasons FROM teams t JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid AND t.lgid = th.lgid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid AND t.lgid = ts.lgid WHERE t.year >= 2018 AND t.year <= 1936 GROUP BY t.tmid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(t.w) > 152 AND AVG(t.rank1) < 37 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;
