SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1988 AND t.year <= 1959 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seriespost sp WHERE sp.year = t.year AND (sp.tmidwinner = t.tmid OR sp.tmidloser = t.tmid)) GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 59 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, t.year, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1963 AND t.year <= 1989 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.gp > 98 GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 11 ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.year ASC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1985 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1975 AND t.year <= 1928 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 1062 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.lgid, t.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS distinct_players, COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerid) AS distinct_goalies, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(CAST(g.sho AS INTEGER)) AS total_shutouts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid WHERE t.year >= 1964 AND t.year <= 2003 GROUP BY t.lgid, t.year HAVING SUM(s.g) > 3179 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS pts_rank FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 1997 AND s.pts > 131 ORDER BY s.year DESC, pts_rank ASC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2016 AND s.pts > 100 ORDER BY s.year, rank_by_points;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid ORDER BY s.g DESC) AS rank_by_goals_by_league, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.lgid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts_by_league, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 1992 AND s.pts > 55 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 39 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, s.lgid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 80 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.name AS team_name, t.lgid AS league, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year >= 2012.37 AND t.lgid LIKE 'NHL' GROUP BY t.name, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 681.28 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2016 AND t.year <= 1992 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points FROM scoring s JOIN awardsplayers a ON s.playerid = a.playerid AND s.year = a.year WHERE s.g > 11 AND a.year >= 1980 GROUP BY s.playerid ORDER BY total_goals DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid WHERE s.year >= 2016 AND s.g > 5 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY s.pts DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year ORDER BY s.pts DESC) AS rank_by_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.year, s.lgid ORDER BY s.g DESC) AS rank_by_goals_by_league, AVG(s.pts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.lgid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_pts_by_league, SUM(s.g) OVER (PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS career_total_goals FROM scoring s JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.coachid JOIN teams t ON s.tmid = t.tmid AND s.year = t.year WHERE s.year >= 2007 AND s.pts > 97 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' AND s.g >= 10 GROUP BY s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, s.pim, s.lgid, t.lgid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 284 ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.pts DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name, SUM(t.w) AS total_wins, AVG(t.rank1) AS avg_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers, MAX(s.pts) AS max_player_pts FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2020 AND t.year <= 1998 AND t.w > 75 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(t.w) > 68 ORDER BY total_wins DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.year, t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.g) DESC) AS goals_rank FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year BETWEEN 1963 AND 1921 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 202 ORDER BY t.year DESC, goals_rank ASC;

SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awardsplayers ap WHERE ap.playerid = m.p_id AND ap.year >= 2018) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN scoring s ON m.p_id = s.playerid WHERE s.year >= 1996 AND s.g > 96 GROUP BY m.p_id, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying WHERE ap.year >= 1990 AND ap.year <= 2022 GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 35 INTERSECT SELECT m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname, COUNT(ap.award) AS award_count FROM master m JOIN awardsplayers ap ON m.playerid::character varying = ap.playerid::character varying JOIN hof h ON m.hofid = h.hofid WHERE h.category = 'Player' GROUP BY m.playerid, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING COUNT(ap.award) > 46 ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS player_count, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals FROM teams t LEFT JOIN scoring s ON t.tmid = s.tmid AND t.year = s.year WHERE t.year = 1935 AND t.lgid = 'NHL' GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name HAVING SUM(s.g) > 165 ORDER BY total_goals DESC;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_prev_year FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 32 AND t2.w > 49 ORDER BY t1.tmid, t1.year;
SELECT t1.tmid, t1.year, t1.w AS wins, t2.w AS wins_against FROM teams t1 JOIN teams t2 ON t1.tmid = t2.tmid AND t1.year = t2.year + 1 WHERE t1.w > 26 AND t2.w > 24 ORDER BY t1.year DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_pct, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.playerid) AS award_players_count FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year >= 2007 AND (t.w > 36 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teamshalf th WHERE th.year_tmid = t.pk_id AND th.half = 1 AND th.w > 25)) GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.g HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.69 ORDER BY win_pct DESC, total_player_points DESC;

SELECT t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts, SUM(s.pts) AS total_player_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid WHERE t.year IN (SELECT year FROM awardsplayers WHERE award = 'Hart Trophy') GROUP BY t.tmid, t.name, t.year, t.w, t.l, t.pts HAVING t.pts > 146 ORDER BY total_player_points DESC;

SELECT s.playerid, s.year, s.g, s.a, s.pts, AVG(s.pts) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.playerid ORDER BY s.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS rolling_avg_pts FROM scoring s WHERE s.year >= 2013 AND s.pts > 23 ORDER BY s.playerid, s.year;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, AVG(s.a) AS avg_assists_per_player, AVG(s.pts) AS avg_points_per_player, SUM(g.gp) AS total_goalie_games, SUM(g.w) AS total_goalie_wins, SUM(g.l) AS total_goalie_losses, SUM(g.t) AS total_goalie_ties, AVG(g.ga) AS avg_goals_against_per_game, SUM(CASE WHEN ap.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS player_award_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ac.award IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coach_award_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.hofid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hall_of_fame_inductees, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.lgid ORDER BY SUM(s.pts) DESC) AS league_points_rank, LAG(SUM(s.pts), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year) AS prev_year_points, SUM(SUM(s.pts)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tmid ORDER BY t.year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3yr_points FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN goaliessc g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmid = g.tmid LEFT JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year LEFT JOIN awardscoaches ac ON t.tmid = ac.lgid AND t.year = ac.year LEFT JOIN hof h ON t.year = h.year AND t.lgid = h.category JOIN teamshalf th ON t.year = th.year AND t.tmid = th.tmid JOIN teamspost tp ON t.year = tp.year AND t.tmid = tp.tmid JOIN teamssc ts ON t.year = ts.year AND t.tmid = ts.tmid JOIN teamsplits tsp ON t.year = tsp.year AND t.tmid = tsp.tmid JOIN teamvsteam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmid = tv.tmid WHERE t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 1956 AND t.rank1 <= 26 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.pts) > 4305 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) >= 20 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_players, SUM(s.g) AS total_goals, AVG(s.g) AS avg_goals_per_player, SUM(s.a) AS total_assists, SUM(s.pts) AS total_points FROM teams t INNER JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid LEFT JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id WHERE t.year >= 1984 AND t.year <= 1947 GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING SUM(s.g) > 165 ORDER BY t.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid, SUM(t.g) AS total_games, AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) AS win_percentage, COUNT(DISTINCT s.playerid) AS unique_scorers FROM teams t JOIN scoring s ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmid = s.tmid JOIN master m ON s.playerid = m.p_id JOIN awardsplayers ap ON s.playerid = ap.playerid AND s.year = ap.year WHERE t.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 1923 AND t.g > 38 AND s.gp > 70 AND ap.award = 'Hart Trophy' GROUP BY t.year, t.lgid, t.tmid HAVING AVG(t.w::numeric / NULLIF(t.g, 0)) > 0.09 ORDER BY total_games DESC, win_percentage DESC;
